body:
The fight against Rick Scott is far from over
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87219342/480444822/1820369458?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1384-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzc0MjZiYjYtOTgyZS1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=tGchCOvZE_hQZeZixxZYKjSu9ODg_OpuhLE5OzxcXnA=)
Thank you so much for all your support and for standing with me in my fight to flip Florida blue, friend.
I can't even begin to express how much your commitment means to me, but I can tell you right now — none of this would be remotely possible without you. Our campaign has come a LONG way, but here's where it all started:
At 14, I left my home in Ecuador with my mom and sisters in search of a better life. I went from making minimum wage at a local doughnut shop to being the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress. That, my friend, is the American dream.
But it didn't come easy. I had to work hard and fight to get where I am today. And that's why I relate to the hardworking families all across the U.S. I've spent my life in public service fighting to expand opportunities for every single American, from making health care affordable to advocating for gun violence prevention and reproductive freedom.

Hey - my name is Byron Donalds.

As Co-Chair of one of the most important initiatives of the Republican Party, I wanted you to what we're doing right now to lay the groundwork for the biggest GOP landslide in AMERICAN HISTORY!

_**[A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen- so bear with me for a minute:](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=d250e20139134c32a9957f7aa8865f92&_e=EYqQZ0JzEfxJ17RAGdtVvLn6HRpQjEbk-zf33mdZqkf4YC6yqplN_ZZioo5RZcECFShIaakf4kIu2JyPZd6_n3UQ4cOaXiGI9dcJyc07xGNnTi7RkaZiTuudTZpRs1SZ454XPEDdSWfK_HHXfuFExhm77KY6D46IErCayD7xyWUp-A_dcmGLRGKyU3BpV2oJkHWRZS1ojNb7f1VFEKFqqQBuciYsQdze_FnZ3btekWibRX3mrH9Bds-jw8WP09OOV3X-LKNHkx5eTjGpkH11F8iHW2R7pGU128MGFsovhGpw4CPfJCgm7xw91VKVUec8ayRTQ9JpNFj97YerucvjaHsatqVjaXXMe9qOKGjx4FwIUhwrbQ7-oFlY-LzWccc5CU8Snx2iQuRbu9llsu2jXg%3D%3D "A lot goes into building the most powerful election-winning machine our country has ever seen – so bear with me for a minute:")**_

-> If the Democrat Legal Machine tries any shenanigans, we'll be there to stop them
-> If Liberals can ballot harvest, we should ballot harvest even better
-> If they're sending poll watchers, we should send an army of our own
-> We're not pandering to minority voters, we're building relationships with them
-> We're expanding GOTV efforts to get young Conservatives to the ballot box
-> We're fighting bad election laws to make it easier to vote but harder to cheat

These are the nuts and bolts of winning campaigns up and down the ballot. And I'm proud to help lead these efforts.

As Conservatives, we have the issues on our side. We are the only commonsense Party. **If we get these campaign operations right, the Democrats are in serious trouble come election day.**

_But I have to be honest with you: building this level of infrastructure is very expensive._ We're running ads in costly swing-state markets, printing campaign literature, filling up gas tanks to knock doors, recruiting volunteers, and scaling up our voter contact programs.

And unlike the Democrats, we don't rely on Liberal billionaires and rich celebrities for funding.

name: Lexi Reese
subject: Update & Invitation
body:
New Chapter & Invite to LinkedIn Live June 20th (tomorrow @ 11:15 am PT, 2:15 am ET) | | | | |
---
| Hi friends,
Happy Juneteenth! I wanted to share with you a quick update and an invitation for tomorrow [[**HERE**](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=0da52d1de4&e=0f9388ee95)].
This will be my last email for a while ([**Substack**](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=90e9cc6182&e=0f9388ee95) will stay live with monthly posts if you want to subscribe!). If this is where you stop reading, thank you _immensely_ for your support during the Senate campaign. It meant more than I could ever properly express.
**Update:**
Since we last left off, I have joined [Lanai Software](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=730f962117&e=0f9388ee95) as co-founder, CEO. Lanai helps large companies organize Generative AI information and make it visible, secure, and actionable. We aim to ensure this next wave of technology unleashes the ability for humans to do extraordinary things, applying lessons of what worked (and what didn’t) from the last twenty years in the Internet age.
You might wonder how this aligns with the Senate campaign. Both involved bringing something new to market – a political campaign in which I was the product (though really we were trying to bring a new type of leadership to market) and Lanai in which a software platform is the product. We had product-market fit in the campaign, but fundraising limitations hampered building awareness as much and as quickly as we needed it. While disappointed, I am so proud of the LR4S team and of reframing the conversation about Congress' role in driving real inclusive prosperity.
Now, I'm focusing on impact from different angles. Lanai will help companies that employ 30% of the world’s workforce adopt AI consciously, effectively and well. I could not ask for a better co-founder in Steve Herrod, former CTO of VMware, and investors like Juxtapose and Lux. I have also started the [Courageous Leaders Fund](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=abb515737b&e=0f9388ee95) to help new voices run for Congress in the 2024 cycle.
**Invitation:**
My latest post, [**Crisis & Change: Redefining Humanitarian Action in a Wired World**](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=f2389f2e8f&e=0f9388ee95), is out.
In honor of Juneteenth, and inspired by MLK's words “No one is free until we are all free”, I'm hosting a LinkedIn Live discussion tomorrow at 11:15 am PT / 2:15 PM ET with [**Tjada D'Oyen McKenna**](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=a8cc600c83&e=0f9388ee95)**,** the **CEO of Mercy Corps** on the role all of us can play in securing a more peaceful, resilient world for generations to come.
**RSVP** : [[HERE](https://substack.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=833a984b31aaa09af9ff0ffae&id=92964cac67&e=0f9388ee95)]
Hope to see you there!
With Gratitude,Lexi

Hey Fellow Ohio Democrat,
It’s Tamie Wilson, the woman running for U.S. Congress to unseat Ohio’s biggest embarrassment - Jim Jordan! Yeah, THAT guy!
I’m reaching out to you to invite you to my campaign kickoff event with special guest David Pepper. (Click here for more event information.) [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dela-fund]

Last week, Jim Jordan led the effort as House Judiciary Chair to do Trump’s bidding and destroy the credibility of the American legal system - all with the goal to prevent new convictions and undermine Trump's historic felony conviction. Jim Jordan believes he is above the law, and he has illegally defied a Congressional subpoena for 766 days.
I can and will unseat him. I am running a strong campaign to remove the most dangerous man in Congress. I bet you’ll be surprised to know 70% of the district are Independent voters. My internal polling is showing 42% of voters in the Ohio 4th support our campaign , while Jim Jordan is polling at 48% throughout the district. We are using our resources to run a moderate common-sense approach campaign that targets independents. I need your help getting my message out to persuade these key independent voters so we can flip this seat once and for all.
I have so much to share, and I will be doing so at my campaign kickoff event. One of the most exciting things I can tell you is that I am polling within 6% of Jordan!
This is THE year we will kick Jim Jordan out of Congress!

# Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week:
Last week, I spoke with the IBEW, I marched with the Plymouth Co Democrats in the Ice Cream Days Parade in LeMars, and I spoke at the Iowa Democratic Party State Convention.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: I moved on from any anger I had at the DCCC for abandoning our congressional district and ignoring me (they haven't acknowledged my existence in any way a single time, and I've been running since January '22) long ago. I love my county-level leaders and fight the good fight with them without national support.
However, I'll admit I was displeased when a supporter in my district sent me a fundraising letter they received this week from the DCCC. The letter acknowledged the supporter was in IA-04, said they were asking for funds to open new HQ's, and that they had recently opened one in Iowa. The supporter read the letter as suggesting a new HQ would possibly open in our district.
Well, I have received no communication about that or literally anything else ever from the DCCC. I have 0% confidence they'll open an HQ in IA-04 or provide us any other kind of support out here at all. So, the letter struck me as rather disingenuous and misleading.
Just so you know, if you donate per that letter, that money is leaving our district.
I personally am at peace being completely independent from the national party. I do what I want. I say what I want. I'm no one's puppet. But if anyone at the DCCC is reading this, which I highly doubt, just be real with my Democratic friends here in my district. Tell them any money they give you will not stay in our district.
Our schedule for this week: -On Monday 6/17, I spoke with the Western Iowa Labor Federation and drove up to Arnolds Park in Dickinson County to speak with the county Democrats up there. -On Tuesday 6/18, I spoke with the ISEA about public education in Iowa and also spoke to folks at a multi-county fundraiser at Yellowsmoke Park in Denison. -On Wednesday 6/19, I spoke with the Iowa Democratic Party Climate Caucus. -On Thursday 6/20, I'll be at Prairie Moon in Ames at 6 PM for the IDP Hall of Fame Event there. -On Saturday 6/22 at 11 am, I'll be at the Boone County Democrats' Picnic in Madrid, before driving up to Fort Dodge to speak at Fort Dodge Pride at Fort Frenzy. -On Sunday 6/23, I'll be at the Rockwell City library at noon to chat with the Calhoun County Democrats, before heading back up to Fort Dodge for the 2 pm IDP Hall of Fame Event there at Elks Lodge.
Recent press/social media posts of note: https://iowacapitaldispatch.com/2024/06/15/iowa-democrats-at-state-convention-pin-2024-hopes-on-abortion-education-issues/
We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers
Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com!
Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton

clean_body: | | | | == | == | Melton for Iowa 2024 | Hello Peter, This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc. Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I spoke with the IBEW, I marched with the Plymouth Co Democrats in the Ice Cream Days Parade in LeMars, and I spoke at the Iowa Democratic Party State Convention. The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: I moved on from any anger I had at the DCCC for abandoning our congressional district and ignoring me (they haven't acknowledged my existence in any way a single time, and I've been running since January '22) long ago. I love my county-level leaders and fight the good fight with them without national support. However, I'll admit I was displeased when a supporter in my district sent me a fundraising letter they received this week from the DCCC. The letter acknowledged the supporter was in IA-04, said they were asking for funds to open new HQ's, and that they had recently opened one in Iowa. The supporter read the letter as suggesting a new HQ would possibly open in our district. Well, I have received no communication about that or literally anything else ever from the DCCC. I have 0% confidence they'll open an HQ in IA-04 or provide us any other kind of support out here at all. So, the letter struck me as rather disingenuous and misleading. Just so you know, if you donate per that letter, that money is leaving our district. I personally am at peace being completely independent from the national party. I do what I want. I say what I want. I'm no one's puppet. But if anyone at the DCCC is reading this, which I highly doubt, just be real with my Democratic friends here in my district. Tell them any money they give you will not stay in our district. Our schedule for this week: -On Monday 6/17, I spoke with the Western Iowa Labor Federation and drove up to Arnolds Park in Dickinson County to speak with the county Democrats up there. -On Tuesday 6/18, I spoke with the ISEA about public education in Iowa and also spoke to folks at a multi-county fundraiser at Yellowsmoke Park in Denison. -On Wednesday 6/19, I spoke with the Iowa Democratic Party Climate Caucus. -On Thursday 6/20, I'll be at Prairie Moon in Ames at 6 PM for the IDP Hall of Fame Event there. -On Saturday 6/22 at 11 am, I'll be at the Boone County Democrats' Picnic in Madrid, before driving up to Fort Dodge to speak at Fort Dodge Pride at Fort Frenzy. -On Sunday 6/23, I'll be at the Rockwell City library at noon to chat with the Calhoun County Democrats, before heading back up to Fort Dodge for the 2 pm IDP Hall of Fame Event there at Elks Lodge. Recent press/social media posts of note: We again are rejecting all Corporate PAC money, so we really rely on, and are extremely grateful for your support. We'll spend your donations on ways to expand our reach to as many voters as possible, including: -Post cards and other mailers and postage -Hand out cards for events -Text messaging campaigns -Transportation costs for events and door knocking -Campaign website costs -Radio ads, Social Media Ads, and (hopefully) TV ads -Our campaign staffers Finally, if you have anyone else in mind that would like to be added to our email list or who would be interested in volunteering, let us know at melton4iowa@gmail.com! Let's keep fighting the good fight together! Ryan Melton == | | | | | | | | == | == == == | == | P.O. Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Embattled IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy Resigns Effective July 19, Blames Rise of "Grassroots," Leaves Behind a Record of Massive GOP Losses (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review
On Wednesday, Illinois Republican Party Chairman Don Tracy submitted his resignation as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the powerful “grassroots,” party infighting and the recent removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman.

Tracy also blamed the rise of the “grassroots,” writing, “Like Vince Kolber, my friend and former Finance Committee Chair, I am also concerned about the current infatuation of some members of the SCC, few as they are, with certain individuals they call “grass roots” leaders.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

For the last two years, this publication has consistently called on Tracy to resign. And on November 21, 2022, just weeks after massive and widespread GOP losses during the midterm election, IR editor-in-chief Mark Vargas wrote an opinion piece titled, “It’s Time for Don Tracy to Resign, Now,” writing (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/11/vargas-its-time-for-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-to-resign-now.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ,

“It’s also going to take new Illinois GOP leadership – and it is why I am calling on IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy to resign.

Resign Now.

The people of Illinois need to know that the GOP is serious about rebuilding and putting the best team in place to win.

If Don Tracy can take credit for victories, then he most certainly can take responsibility for losses. And the losses were many.”

Since November of 2022, this publication has published dozens of
articles (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/tag/don-tracy?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) critical of Tracy and calling on him to resign. And last June, 30 organizations representing over 80,000 conservative grassroots (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/ir-exclusive-30-organizations-across-illinois-representing-over-80000-grassroots-activists-sign-an-open-letter-of-no-confidence-in-il-gop-chair-don-tracys-leadership.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=d3f9194d62-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) activists from across the state, signed an open letter and shared exclusively with this publication, calling on the Illinois Republican State Central Committee to remove Don Tracy as chairman of the state party in a motion of “No Confidence.” In the letter, the grassroots wrote,

“The state of the Illinois Republican Party is not good. Under chairman Don Tracy’s leadership, fundraising is a struggle, party infighting has made its way into the pages of the Chicago Tribune, Politico and Crain’s Chicago Business – and more importantly, the conservative grassroots base – the heart, soul and backbone of the Illinois Republican Party, feels ignored – and their volunteer efforts minimized.”

Mike knows what it means to fight back against cancel culture and he's coming to share his unfiltered, uncensored vision for securing America's future. **Dave Duquette, founder of Western Justice,** and recent Emmy Award winner for his debut movie "Pocatello Land Grab." Fighting back and exposing corrupt government actors working to take rural property away from the hard working, multi-generational land owners. **Joining the line-up is Andy Pollack** , a man who turned profound personal loss into a national campaign for school safety. Not more politicians willing to say anything and do anything to get elected. **Please don't be fooled by Celeste Maloy's recent poll-driven decisions, and be on alert to expect more from her until next Tuesday.Thank you,Colby

subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z431m8nq8lei6rnqf5a2mbf8fksgboq027riv4p8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor3cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2znvebe6ig7t77up6lkgmvm4388qh688ma5coent0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor3cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zejdthe78m2343lkm8b17jnb6c1rsbk2flt4gja8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor3cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. name: Riley Gaines, Leadership Institute
subject: Do you have your copy yet?
body:
They're told men deserve women's trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women's locker rooms.

| Friend, You may have heard my story. I'm the swimmer from the University of Kentucky who was forced to compete against a man at the women's NCAA championships.
But I'm not speaking out because of what happened to me. Rather, I'm speaking louder because there are thousands of young women and girls who are told they need to "shut up." They're told men deserve women's trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women's locker rooms. **Well, I disagree. And I will not shut up.** [I won't sit by and let other women and girls have their accomplishments erased and their safety put at risk.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z4rf4gjpimf7auuvfmbl8qjhko71didgpp5efm6g_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor5c9h2bs) [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zc543mukgeoa543cuem7crahno4p75r6onq59kd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor5c9h2bs) I joined the **Leadership Institute** to educate, activate, and mobilize thousands of young women and men to fight for their rights. The Leadership Institute organized and funded my speaking tour on college campuses all over the country. My colleagues and I start conversations, recruit ambassadors, and help others make a big difference in their communities. My team at the Leadership Institute and I plan to go back on the road this fall, speaking out across the country. [Will you donate $1,000, $500, $250, $100, or even $50 to support this most urgent effort?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zn1thqdsq9g7qu5bsjlrh0udv9a5q6dhot1pbp9o_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor5c9h2bs) If you donate at least $100 you will get a copy of my new book! [Friend, please donate as generously as you can right now! And remember, if you give $100 or more, you'll get a copy of my new book.](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zp931mkh65qptbdthm30es8363se3h2csp5vngu8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jmeor5c9h2bs) Sincerely, Riley Gaines Director, The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

| | Friend,They lied about the origin of Covid... they lied about the data... and they lied about the science. They called you a conspiracy theorist, accused you of spreading misinformation and even banned you from social media.They said it was OK for you to shop at big box stores and participate in race riots – while they closed down your church, small businesses and schools. And then they demanded that you take an experimental vaccine if you wanted to travel, go out in public, or even keep your job. Millions of Americans reluctantly complied even though they felt like this was a violation of their bodily autonomy – and in some case, their religious beliefs.**Tens of thousands of hardworking Americans refused to give in and were fired when they refused to get the Covid shot.** Doctors, nurses, teachers, members of the military, and many more.And now that we know more of the truth about Covid, the vaccine, and the shady collusion between government organizations, Big Tech and Big Pharma......they’d love nothing more than to sweep this all under the rug and pretend it never happened. **That’s why I’ve instructed our attorneys at the Center for American Liberty to continue legal action to hold them accountable.** For starters, we filed a lawsuit against the North Carolina Symphony on behalf of three musicians fired for refusing to get the COVID vaccine. _Each of them had been employed by the_ _ __Symphony_ _ __for over 10 years._[**And if we can win this critical legal battle, we can put employers across the country on notice that they should reinstate victims of their COVID vaccine firings.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zbuuhi140nkqj559kjpv34v3ofoa1tip77mdi790_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jm1pb1chh2bs) When the Symphony first introduced its vaccine mandate, it offered both religious and medical exemptions.Dovid, Chris, and Rachel filed for religious exemptions, and expressed a willingness to take other measures—like regular COVID testing—to ensure safety.But the Symphony rejected ALL of them and put them on a year of UNPAID LEAVE.These three musicians were Buddhist, Christian and Jewish.**To you and me, the freedom to practice your religion is a sacred right.****So is your right to bodily autonomy.** But in the eyes of the cultural Marxists who control so many institutions in America today, your body doesn’t belong to you – it belongs to them.They’ll decide where you go... They’ll decide what you need... They’ll decide what you can have... They’ll decide what vaccines you must take...In other words: _Your individual liberties_ will cease to exist. The good news is that while cultural Marxism is booming on college campuses and inside government bureaucracies......the vast majority of Americans are against it. This is a fight we can win – and we must win. [**You can join me today by making a generous, tax-deductible donation to the Center for American Liberty to fund this lawsuit for medical and religious freedom, and set a precedent nationwide that puts these radicals on notice.**](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr0a4ehc9tn220h31rcslo6mkv73fnp6k0kf6bf0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jm1pb1chh2bs) Even after the North Carolina Symphony lifted its vaccine mandate, it refused to give these musicians their jobs back.Because it was never about “science” or “health” – it was always about control.And it’s time to tell the cultural Marxists who want to control every aspect of your life that we aren’t backing down.I hope I can count on your support.

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z62kj6j0f2nvtfdq9kb6i3e5i2gg5gdgvokv97l0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jm1pb1chh2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zsmrs32j2jn4o61atqgrufkfvmmg632dpm0ekco8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jm1pb1chh2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2za5u1e3cvmnr5corh0u0mmoqtbme49gpj58kh9f0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3jm1pb1chh2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Riley Gaines, Leadership Institute
subject: Do you have your copy yet?
body:
They're told men deserve women's trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women's locker rooms.

| Friend, You may have heard my story. I'm the swimmer from the University of Kentucky who was forced to compete against a man at the women's NCAA championships.
But I'm not speaking out because of what happened to me. Rather, I'm speaking louder because there are thousands of young women and girls who are told they need to "shut up." They're told men deserve women's trophies. That men deserve their scholarships. And that men should use women's locker rooms. **Well, I disagree. And I will not shut up.** [I won't sit by and let other women and girls have their accomplishments erased and their safety put at risk.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z9fg2t5ul1cglehc9uo66dn0cl0p5g2ge8kutggo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge4p30cjh2bs) [](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zpveqp3u7fcumbku5tmncg61lc8mdtu8qcmfunl8_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge4p30cjh2bs) I joined the **Leadership Institute** to educate, activate, and mobilize thousands of young women and men to fight for their rights. The Leadership Institute organized and funded my speaking tour on college campuses all over the country. My colleagues and I start conversations, recruit ambassadors, and help others make a big difference in their communities. My team at the Leadership Institute and I plan to go back on the road this fall, speaking out across the country. [Will you donate $1,000, $500, $250, $100, or even $50 to support this most urgent effort?](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2z2brea5ftbv171eintc83b4rm8tbmcncqm7nkgeo_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge4p30cjh2bs) If you donate at least $100 you will get a copy of my new book! [Friend, please donate as generously as you can right now! And remember, if you give $100 or more, you'll get a copy of my new book.](https://e.updateforamerica.com/rd/9z2zfq95aq5e75am7216fbcrcqesmlk59khjnmi88no_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge4p30cjh2bs) Sincerely, Riley Gaines Director, The Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute

body:
Three years ago this week, my friend, Siaka Massaquoi, was terrorized by people who were supposed to protect him.

[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zj1jp92k0dv010jqhe2boco39gpo8vheqnqkntmg_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge2o73c1h2bs)

[**Please give a crucial $25, $50, $100 or more now to support my critically important lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to get justice for January 6 peaceful protesters and set them free!**

](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zv75hb1dbppaotoi622bqq6qdokau2vicfd5qps0_rp22sh2s8i6ep30s3ge2o73c1h2bs) Like you, my clients are law-abiding patriots who thought the FBI would never knock on their door.

**They were wrong.**

Now, here's what happened to Siaka Massaquoi ...

Siaka is a brand new father and a skilled actor who starred in a Babylon Bee hit comedy series.

He peacefully protested the stolen presidential election on January 6, 2021 ... and spent 71 seconds inside the U.S. Capitol building.

**Fifteen FBI agents raided Siaka 's home with their guns drawn at 5:45 AM on June 10, 2021. They handcuffed him, his best friend, and two other roommates. **

His best friend's two little children, just three and seven years old, were _scared to death._

You'll be shocked by what the FBI did next:

* They dragged Siaka out of his home
* They refused to let him speak to his lawyer
* They refused to show him the arrest warrant
* They grilled him and his friends for five hours

To add insult to injury, the FBI agents seized his cell phones, computers, personal notebooks, and two Make American Great Again baseball caps.

And because the FBI didn't arrest or charge Siaka, he has no legal grounds to find out why they raided his home...terrorized him, his friends, his friend's little children... abused his Constitutionally protected rights...and stole his property.

Siaka's suffering didn't end there, though.

**I 'm sorry to say Siaka was arrested by a FBI SWAT Team in front of his wife, Charlotte, and their unborn son, Xavier, just a short time ago. They refused to show Charlotte the arrest warrant.**

Joe Biden's corrupt Department of Justice claims he committed four misdemeanors, including "parading" in the US Capitol. And he faces prison time, even though he's innocent.

It won't surprise you my other client, Jesus Rivera, is also innocent.

Jesus is a U.S. Marine combat veteran and a family man.

He videoed the protest outside the Capitol building for a local news station back home in Florida. And he peacefully entered the Capitol like many other patriots that day.

**Between 12 to 20 heavily armed FBI agents raided his home around 7:30 AM just two weeks later. They had no probable cause, and the search warrant was obtained through lies, even outright fraud.**

You see, the FBI didn't care that Jesus committed no crime.

Or that he survived rocket attacks and exploding roadside bombs trying to bring freedom to the people of Iraq and Afghanistan.

They trampled on his rights ... then a leftist judge threw him in prison for 8 months!

As you know, Siaka, Jesus, and many other January 6 peaceful protesters are innocent men and women. But they've been thrown to the wolves by Joe Biden's lawless lawyers and out of control special agents anyway.

And if you support President Trump ... or if you've spoken up for fair, honest elections ... or you've made it known you're alarmed about the direction America is headed ...

**I have to ask you, when will the FBI knock on your door?**

Well, there's something you can do about it!

**I 've filed crucial lawsuits to free January 6 peaceful protesters. Including a critical new lawsuit that proves the FBI and other agencies broke the law by carrying out illegal surveillance on January 6 patriots. That means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.**

This powerful new lawsuit will rein in the FBI, too.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Plus I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect you, your family, our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

To be frank with you, I feel a growing sense of urgency about these crucial efforts.

Not just because no other legal group in America is doing what Freedom Watch is doing.

**But also because law-abiding Americans are getting thrown into dangerous prisons ...they can be torn from their spouses and children for years, even decades...and you and I know the abuse, torture, and horror peaceful protesters are already enduring in the D.C. jail right now.**

There isn't a second to spare.

[**Patriot, please help me fight back peacefully and legally for Siaka, Jesus, all January 6 patriots and the rest of us who may get a knock on our door by the FBI next. Your critically important gift of at least of $25, $50, $100, or more immediately will help make that possible.**

Thank you so much!

In Justice,

Larry Klayman
Founder, Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: be ready . . .
body:
The Abortion Lobby is plotting something dangerous...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

Any time the Supreme Court of the United States (SCOTUS) takes up an abortion-related case, it’s a news and PR madhouse in Washington, D.C.

So, it’s crucial that _Students for Life Action’s_ _**SCOTUS SQUAD**_ is there on-site during arguments and the day the Court announces their decisions.

You see, our _**SCOTUS SQUAD**_ – _a deployment team composed of dozens of enthusiastic, young pro-lifers_ – has done incredible work in the past standing up to the pro-abortion mob on the steps of the Supreme Court.

Our pro-life presence at the highest court in the land is important . . . as our _**SCOTUS SQUAD**_ ensures that the media doesn't ignore them with their cameras.

For example, we were out there last week when the Court sent the critical Chemical Abortion Pill case back to lower courts over a standing issue, which ensured our talking point about how the FDA has been putting mothers’ lives at risk to advance their abortion agenda won’t have the final say.

And we will be out there this week and next when the Court finally announces their decision in the _Idaho and Moyle v. United States_ case, where the pro-life state of Idaho is fighting back against the Biden Administration’s HHS that is trying to force every emergency room in America to commit abortions!

**[So, would you please consider making your most generous contribution towards our SCOTUS SQUAD right away to help me make sure they have everything they need to counter the pro-abortion mob at the Supreme Court](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gsuln-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, we can’t let the Abortion Lobby steal the national spotlight . . . _Not with November right around the corner._

And we certainly can’t let them use their intimidation tactics towards the Supreme Court Justices to try and make them cave to their demands.

You and I both know the Abortion Lobby would love nothing more than to overrun Capitol Hill with a pro-abortion mob to try and force the Supreme Court into making pro-abortion decisions that they’re happy with.

Remember, the _Dobbs_ leak was ALL about intimidation.

**One person even intended to assassinate Justice Brett Kavanaugh . . .**

And the Abortion Lobby’s failure has only made them become more radical.

Riots, mob intimidation, firebombing Pregnancy Resource Centers, and even committing brutal violence against pro-lifers is just some of what we already know they’re capable of.

We know because we saw some of the worst when _Roe v. Wade_ was reversed.

Pro-abortion goons descended on several Supreme Court Justices' HOUSES to intimidate their families – _which is illegal, by the way!_

But of course, President Biden’s Department of Justice is always quick to overlook the extremism of these pro-abortion whack jobs.

So that means if the Supreme Court issues a pro-life ruling this week or next, there will be almost nothing standing between these radicals and the Supreme Court Justices.

Nothing except our _**SCOTUS SQUAD** ,_ that is . . .
[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gsuln-duchtdja-j/)
These brave young women and men are putting themselves on the line for the sake of justice, and even risking their safety for the lives of the preborn.

But they can’t do it alone.

**[So, will you please consider a generous contribution of $250, $100, $75, or $50 right away if you can’t join us on the Supreme Court steps](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gsuln-duchtdja-i/)?**

Coffee, donuts, sandwiches, a few dollars in gas money, and a sugary soda are what’s powering our **_SCOTUS SQUAD_** these days.

**[Even a gift of just $25 or $10 will help](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gsuln-duchtdja-d/)!**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/li63Vl__EbZ-AsEAsy54pw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoVox4P0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA2MjBXA3NwY0IKZm2l83Nm7QR88VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/li63Vl__EbZ-AsEAsy54pw~~/AARclAA~/RgRoVox4P0SwaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtQ0ItMjAyNDA2MjBXA3NwY0IKZm2l83Nm7QR88VIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## U.S. Military Kills Senior ISIS Official
The U.S. military says it [killed a senior ISIS official](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFuwyAQgOGngY3oOJ-xMzB08ZauHS0ER3wNCZGhrvL2VTt3_qV_-D4u6yVIkcf1PdzZ91zXELscvDqDYJBW0slnZuRBs7eTned5dtbpzScMxOdhQmRymcd0ZqDoiBJnmKekxSMggUOAM1pyp0gBItlhHoGdHaMi4CS97qfPKo--cS6vevB-ivWui996fzY1vClcFC59401K-W0Kl2ctEl8Kl8SZH40VLjQNYEcyX820vsuNzU1KaUaaNFNzliihKFz07tPzW0qR5iZFcL0H-dvq_j_A4fEnAAD__3ACXLw), Usamah Jamal Muhammad Ibrahim al-Janabi, in an airstrike in Syria on Sunday. "His death will disrupt ISIS's ability to resource and conduct terror attacks," U.S. Central Command [informed on X](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjzFv8yAQQH8NbImO48B4YPgUfd6cLpU6WhjOMRWOI5u67b-v0rnrG57ee-uHPuSS77drWNjXaR1CrPngwZ4QTkgDyeQnZmQt2atGOeecVVbOHkG3ITVAoUl24tEkIDO6MSKmqEcts0dAAosALSqy50gBIintDLBVJgoCTrmu2_l9zfc681S-14O3c1wXWfxc62MX-p_ATmD39aQCu8v_6-vlpRfY7TXUj11gpxxocu4ZhMYAqKaVm0-Pz1xK3m0jCG5LyOXXW_--PDz-BAAA__8g-VAG) (formerly Twitter). The strike reportedly caused no civilian casualties. The U.S. has pledged to continue working with regional allies to weaken ISIS and ensure its lasting defeat.
## Biden Streamlines Path for Illegal Immigrants
The Biden administration announced another major [immigration policy shift](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO5CAQRL8GZ1jQZjAXEFzibC690MLQePqEwQJmrNuvX81Km21WUpVKT-_vfb07SpT3P-5A22NZne_0wlVzEBzUqoZgIyLgNKCVszTGGC318LAbBhcioJQ4b-i1Cc5HJeZJaxPjTQ5kQYASGoT4BVLp0SsnvJKTuQnU8uaZEhiolzr-K5T7A2P6X15YR1-OIdlH72dj028GC4Pluq7Rby3j1d49g-UdGSwbBcycjoP26jqVzM9a9uoOXmLE2njC3SXeuuvP9r3LnbezPBs2XiJ_8sY9dfrA_H4cqg3nRSlR0zNTYj8cpS-o_rOil4XPAAAA___muWym) this week, offering 500,000 illegal immigrants a streamlined path to U.S. residency and citizenship. | | | Friend, I fired the bullet that killed Osama bin Laden.

My name is Rob O'Neill, and I'm a former Navy SEAL. When my SEAL Team set out at night in total darkness to eliminate Osama bin Laden, we weren't sure if we'd come back alive.

We knew the place would be well-armed, and we knew bin Laden would be surrounded by his most loyal allies, who would not only kill for him, but they'd be all-too-willing to die to save him.

**However, my Team was just as willing to lay down our lives to exact revenge for the attacks on 9/11 and eliminate America 's biggest and most dangerous enemy.

That's what being a Navy SEAL is about: Going into America's toughest fights ready to risk _everything_ in order to come out victorious.** We're deployed to make sure Americans can sleep peacefully in their beds at night, drop their kids off at school safely, and live without fear of another terrorist attack.

When my fellow Navy SEAL Derrick Van Orden got home to transition into civilian life, he saw the Democrats were working to eliminate the pro-America values he fought to protect during his 26 years in the SEALs.

**They were wrong.**

Now, here's what happened to Siaka Massaquoi ...

Siaka is a brand new father and a skilled actor who starred in a Babylon Bee hit comedy series.

He peacefully protested the stolen presidential election on January 6, 2021 ... and spent 71 seconds inside the U.S. Capitol building.

**Fifteen FBI agents raided Siaka 's home with their guns drawn at 5:45 AM on June 10, 2021. They handcuffed him, his best friend, and two other roommates. **

His best friend's two little children, just three and seven years old, were _scared to death._

You'll be shocked by what the FBI did next:

* They dragged Siaka out of his home
* They refused to let him speak to his lawyer
* They refused to show him the arrest warrant
* They grilled him and his friends for five hours

To add insult to injury, the FBI agents seized his cell phones, computers, personal notebooks, and two Make American Great Again baseball caps.

And because the FBI didn't arrest or charge Siaka, he has no legal grounds to find out why they raided his home...terrorized him, his friends, his friend's little children... abused his Constitutionally protected rights...and stole his property.

Siaka's suffering didn't end there, though.

**I 'm sorry to say Siaka was arrested by a FBI SWAT Team in front of his wife, Charlotte, and their unborn son, Xavier, just a short time ago. They refused to show Charlotte the arrest warrant.**

Joe Biden's corrupt Department of Justice claims he committed four misdemeanors, including "parading" in the US Capitol. And he faces prison time, even though he's innocent.

It won't surprise you my other client, Jesus Rivera, is also innocent.

Jesus is a U.S. Marine combat veteran and a family man.

He videoed the protest outside the Capitol building for a local news station back home in Florida. And he peacefully entered the Capitol like many other patriots that day.

**Between 12 to 20 heavily armed FBI agents raided his home around 7:30 AM just two weeks later. They had no probable cause, and the search warrant was obtained through lies, even outright fraud.**

You see, the FBI didn't care that Jesus committed no crime.

Or that he survived rocket attacks and exploding roadside bombs trying to bring freedom to the people of Iraq and Afghanistan.

They trampled on his rights ... then a leftist judge threw him in prison for 8 months!

As you know, Siaka, Jesus, and many other January 6 peaceful protesters are innocent men and women. But they've been thrown to the wolves by Joe Biden's lawless lawyers and out of control special agents anyway.

And if you support President Trump ... or if you've spoken up for fair, honest elections ... or you've made it known you're alarmed about the direction America is headed ...

**I have to ask you, when will the FBI knock on your door?**

Well, there's something you can do about it!

**I 've filed crucial lawsuits to free January 6 peaceful protesters. Including a critical new lawsuit that proves the FBI and other agencies broke the law by carrying out illegal surveillance on January 6 patriots. That means their criminal convictions can be thrown out. And their criminal trials must stop.**

This powerful new lawsuit will rein in the FBI, too.

I'm Larry Klayman, founder and general counsel for Freedom Watch.

I'm a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who's fought for the American people for 41 years.

You've seen me on CNN, Fox News, and other cable news outlets.

**I 'm the only lawyer in American history to have a court rule that a sitting President had committed a crime. I _guarantee_ Bill Clinton still remembers me!**

And I successfully represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents, and win.****And with this critically important case, I can PROVE IN COURT that Attorney General Merrick Garland, FBI Director Christopher Wray, their departments and agencies at the U.S. Department of Justice ordered and carried out ILLEGAL SURVEILLANCE OF LAW-ABIDING AMERICAN CITIZENS!**

Plus I'm taking other hard-hitting legal actions to protect you, your family, our fellow Americans and our endangered rights and freedoms.

To be frank with you, I feel a growing sense of urgency about these crucial efforts.

Not just because no other legal group in America is doing what Freedom Watch is doing.

**But also because law-abiding Americans are getting thrown into dangerous prisons ...they can be torn from their spouses and children for years, even decades...and you and I know the abuse, torture, and horror peaceful protesters are already enduring in the D.C. jail right now.**

There isn't a second to spare.

[**Patriot, please help me fight back peacefully and legally for Siaka, Jesus, all January 6 patriots and the rest of us who may get a knock on our door by the FBI next. Your critically important gift of at least of $25, $50, $100, or more immediately will help make that possible.**

Hides the corruption of the ruling class

But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached National Survey on the Department of Justice , which you can access at this secure link: Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: 🆘 An overnight victory!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Dr
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/RedLogo.png]
Saving our Soo
Big news, friends! After 18 rounds of negotiations, six months without a contract, two authorized strikes, and several picket lines, the nurses at MyMichigan Sault have finally reached a tentative agreement.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Dr. Bob Lorinser is running for US Congress, fighting for fair wages, universal healthcare, and workers' rights. Your contributions [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob] benefit his campaign and enable Doc to continue advocating for the hardworking people of Northern Michigan and the UP.
JOIN OUR FIGHT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friends,
Thank you to everyone in our community for standing in solidarity, and especially to our nurses for your perseverance throughout this challenging period.
This tentative agreement represents the ideal outcome we aim for during strikes — a victory for nurses, the hospital, patients, and our community.
The health of Northern Michigan and the UP depends on how well we care for our essential workers. We must always show up in solidarity and demand that we put hardworking people before profit.
The credit for this achievement is solely due to the tenacity, grit, and resilience of our workers and their incredible union. Standing shoulder to shoulder with striking nurses in the Soo has been an honor.
A ratification vote will be held on Tuesday!
Congratulations to all involved!
Solidarity forever.
Onward,
-Dr. Bob
Dr. Bob Lorinser, MD, MSW, MPH
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan / Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

Thank you, Laura Maynard, of Remsen, for your [Letter to the Editor in The Post Star](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/09b67dde-b745-4a4d-89be-441d80a2ff15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). It was quite reassuring.
As the days pass following the Battle of the Bots that [attacked my campaign](https://open.substack.com/pub/paulany21/p/thanks-fox-news?r=3g6fcu&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web), a few things have come clear.
**First, the coordinated effort took several hours and possibly several people to pull off.** There was the person or people who attended the Virtual Town Hall Meeting, most likely cloaked, for the purpose of recording it and landing on the "Gotcha!" moment. There was the task of editing to cut off the obvious laughter that followed, as well as the overarching context. There was the task of sending the edited recording to [Fox News to get it accepted for coverage.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/346ee46d-bdba-4191-a482-20617f64a6e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (BTW - the non-Fox News networks are not so interested in perpetuating the incident by carrying it on their networks. I've tried.) Then there was the task of programming the bots to create fake Facebook and "X" accounts to post messages in coordination with the Fox News story, plus timing the attack of the bots for 5:30 after Fox carried it nationwide at 5:00pm. All of this choreography served to inspire MAGA supporters to begin to post angry or lascivious comments, which they started at around 10:00pm and continued relentlessly for about 3 days. I am still living through the fallout, with random waves of calls and texts occurring without warning all these many days later.
Members of my staff continue to monitor social media and Letters to the Editor for remarks of people who believed the fake news carried by the bots.
Let me emphasize once again: people listened to and reacted to inanimate bots.
That's why Laura Maynard's Letter to the Editor was so refreshing. Thank you, Laura!
She was there, on the call.
She heard the remark.
She knew it wasn't a manifesto, or even a serious wish. It was a clumsy toss-off.
**Moving on. **
**The second thing that becomes clear is that the need to look beyond the Republican antics and discuss the real issues has never been more urgent.** Let's talk.
The kitchen table issues in the race for NY-21 include access to **healthcare, access to broadband, and wages.**
Our federal discussion on healthcare can't be limited to simply finding a way to implement universal Medicare. That's important. But I'm talking about the serious need to get medical providers in the North Country. People in St. Lawrence County, where I live, typically have to drive to Syracuse (about 2 hours away by car) to see a primary care physician. If there is an urgent medical need, such as a heart attack, stroke, or my-kid-fell-and-broke-her-arm, an ambulance has to be called, sometimes by helicopter.
This issue of lack of healthcare providers won't be fixed overnight. It is the result of many things: mergers and acquisitions of health care systems; decline of town and community life that makes building a career in the North Country not attractive to a younger medical professional; lack of educational infrastructure to get high school students motivated and educated to serve in healthcare.
The healthcare issue overlaps with a few other issues. We need to step firmly into the 21st century with access to broadband. Build it into the Farm Bill, work with the FCC, or form public-private initiatives - ANYTHING - to make it so that access to the internet is possible in each and every household. Go that last mile, with wifi brought into people's homes. The overlap with the healthcare issue is that school-aged children (and anyone else pursuing an educational program) need to be able to do their homework online at the kitchen table or they won't be able to get the coursework and marks to enter higher education programs in healthcare.
The broadband issue is a quality of life issue. The early-career healthcare professional is simply not going to want to settle in an area where cell phone calls get dropped every-other-mile, or they can't access their favorite social media site while on a break at work.
Without reliable home broadband, small businesses are forced to pay rent in an office building where the internet service is reliable. Individual workers are robbed of the choice to work from home.
Speaking of work...let's discuss wages. Specifically, let's talk about wage suppression or wage disparity. It is reasonable to expect that one 40-hour-a-week job pays enough to support a single person. Sadly, our norm has become one in which an adult might have a job that offers them 25-30 hours a week, paid on Form 1099 (with no withholding, thus leaving the employee to pay taxes at the end of the year). Paying an employee on Form 1099, or as a so-called "contractor", robs all of us of needed payroll tax money, and benefits of workers compensation insurance. It is a spiral that loops back into the health care issue when there is an injury on the job.
Wage suppression or wage disparity wreaks further damage when you consider that the person working 25-30 hours a week has to find another job with compatible hours to pick up the additional 10-15 hours of work (again on Form 1099, as opposed to a W2). If there is a financial crisis (often a medical bill, btw) they have to pick up seasonal or event-based work to cover it. God forbid the hourly wage earner gets a cold or an injury. If they have to miss more than about 3 days of work, they will likely never catch up.
Ask your local retail clerk about this. Ask your part-time restaurant or fast food worker. They will tell you. The 25-30 hour gig might seem like an ideal situation for both employer and employee ("OMG - you have so much free time!"). But it is economically lethal, and sets up a death spiral for entire communities.
No wonder we have a crisis of mental health and addiction in New York.
Bottom line: we need to talk about living wages, sick leave, vacation time (not a luxury - a necessary time to rejuvenate!) and how the lack thereof has long-term consequences for communities.
Let's train our vision not just on what is happening now. There is plenty to distract in the present, as I have experienced recently. But we need to look beyond.
Instead, we need to envision what we want our North Country to look like, feel like, and be like in 10 years - 20 years - 50 years!
Let's reverse the cycle of diminishing population and spiff up the place for newcomers. And they will be here soon.
Much of the United States is becoming environmentally uncomfortable, if not downright unsustainable. Much of California experiences wildfires; many parts of the midwest and west are ravaged by long-term drought. Parts of the Gulf Coast, where I grew up, experience one or more devastating storms each year, often resulting in loss of land mass. My native state, Louisiana loses the [equivalent of a football field each hour](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/48150238-aa4a-4e79-90f6-08add39be26a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Climate change and human-inflicted impacts on the environment are real.
Our North Country counties will increasingly become an option for new residents as domestic migration (people from within the United States) seek to establish residence in other, more sustainable climate zones.
Our agricultural infrastructure is amenable to a protected and sustainable source of food. Our SUNY schools and private colleges are attractive for families, and provide an educated workforce for a wide range of industries. Housing, though expensive, is still less costly than it is in large cities. Our state government is supportive of women's rights and LGBT rights - a major factor for young startup companies when considering whether to locate to a state where abortion and gay or trans rights are banned, as opposed to a state that protects choice.
**Healthcare, broadband, wages ...all of the other things I just described, such as our SUNY schools, housing, and a supportive state government, hinge on these three issues.**
**What do we want the North Country to look like in 50 years? We need to decide - soon. **
**Company is coming, and they 're planning to put down roots and stay.**
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _
