#
Friend of Life,

Planned Parenthood just came out with a new video that calls virginity "made up" and a "social construct."

The "educator" in the video tells young people: "It's time to throw away the notion of losing your virginity."

Instead of seeing it as "losing something," Planned Parenthood encourages impressionable teens to experiment sexually because "all of these myths around sex and virginity can be so hurtful and overwhelming."

Planned Parenthood is grooming the next generation for abortion. Promoting risky sexual practices to young people ultimately leads them to broken relationships and more children killed in the womb.

**Will you help fight back against Planned Parenthood 's anti-family, pro-death agenda? I'm asking 50 people to step forward today with a $50 gift to help us put our life-saving videos into classrooms nationwide**. **[https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5905d0c637c54478a42661e59f0bc1f3&_e=gwGcep-DX0ltOlrSIXIjDZ3tlBHcm42Yc6Co1wpHkrGcDB-xyx6mXJnD9JxuYRFsE6viWY56NS-CQ67Iw7wwCacqI2PKTINZzvECoUoE8fIu9EQAs3F4vzNR8yOMaoyrQC078ZmyG_YnMuN68_C8qKIoroRY2nblgf2hRv31oCfSKVI-Q886SRasBT93qtPcbuILja8a9AqwjHCOWAIi5muPQe8uV6m-HD1YloCg-vPzgLapXEfeuzi5Taf-CtGV1qdVDg9BowxyiKIkc-lc7RFB0UEsjxLkI_vJZS7MLr0Q5fk3-RKmV9i2oB1aSYusCFbCoUXLqM4680v5F3NMvBkZ5Z4G_-jqgmvjPVdTJAY%3D)**

Planned Parenthood has continuously pushed egregious and pornographic materials in schools to young kids and teens -- and what do they "teach" these impressionable kids about sex? That disturbing practices are "normal" and "healthy."

In classic Planned Parenthood fashion, irrefutable definitions are warped, and morality is thrown out the window.

Planned Parenthood is the largest provider of sex education in America -- and they teach kids that gender is fluid, deviant sexual practices are normal and healthy, and anything goes, as long as it's consensual.

**We need to protect our children against Planned Parenthood 's deception. This deadly organization should not be the educator of our children. **

Friend of Life, this is why we at Live Action have been creating - and are about to release! - wholesome sex-ed video series for schools across the country to use instead of Planned Parenthood's damaging materials.

We need to spread the truth about loving relationships between men and women and the beauty of procreation before the next generation of parents is convinced by Planned Parenthood's disturbing agenda that leads to abortion.

**But we can 't complete this critical initiative without your support. Your gift of $50 will help us complete the videos and get them into schools across the country. Use this secure link to make your gift and kick Planned Parenthood out of the classroom! [https://give.liveaction.org/stop-planned-parenthood-mms/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=5905d0c637c54478a42661e59f0bc1f3&_e=gwGcep-DX0ltOlrSIXIjDZ3tlBHcm42Yc6Co1wpHkrGcDB-xyx6mXJnD9JxuYRFsE6viWY56NS-CQ67Iw7wwCacqI2PKTINZzvECoUoE8fIu9EQAs3F4vzNR8yOMaoyrQC078ZmyG_YnMuN68_C8qKIoroRY2nblgf2hRv31oCfSKVI-Q886SRasBT93qtPcbuILja8a9AqwjHCOWAIi5p__JUt5nJidA9wxjVcg2SvdwCECtX4DrgGd-keEBZXd5k5XnTBXHglDZ71dxbNN9gf_eccpZAmfGK-7hFqmBX9z4afECSiENw_Qb0k-7sP88KaiCe8SC6j9Fj2jKmcnk6cfXomKpUL0FdCO81wVGk8%3D)
**
Your partnership gives me so much hope. I can't wait to share the impact your activism will have in months to come. Our children - and grandchildren - depend on it.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

My name is Qasim Rashid. I'm a human rights lawyer residing here in Naperville with my wife Ayesha and our three children. And I'm here to ask the Naperville City Council to uphold justice and divest from the horrific siege on Gaza that has, to date, killed more than 37,000 Palestinian civilians.
As we observe Juneteenth this month, we have much to reflect on, including on the long history of solidarity between Black and African, Palestinian and Arab liberation. This is an especially important moment of learning for us non-Black and non-Arab communities.
The Naperville City Council has received this earnest request from its residents to divest, numerous times--from its Muslim residents, its Jewish residents, its Christian, Hindu, Sikh, Buddhist residents, believer and non-believer residents, of all races and backgrounds.
**But the Naperville City Council has yet to act.**
Is it because the City Council does not have the authority to divest from the siege on Gaza? No. Indeed, as the sovereign elected authority over this city you certainly do.
Is it because there is no precedent of City Councils divesting from foreign countries? No. Indeed more than 90 major American cities divested from apartheid South Africa, and helped enable the passing of federal divestment. Several American cities have already divested from Israel, and many more are taking it under consideration, as are many American universities.
Is it because acknowledging that our dollars are funding war crimes is some fringe position? No. In fact it is the undisputed global consensus.
* In February the International Court of Justice ruled that Israel must "ensure with immediate effect that its military does not commit [genocide]." Israel has since killed an additional 14,000 Palestinians.

* In May, the Chief Prosecutor of the International Criminal Court Karim Khan applied for arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Defense Minister Gallant for crimes against humanity, namely, "the criminal acts of intentionally causing death, starvation, great suffering, and serious injury to body or health of the civilian population."

* Again in May the US State Department admitted that Israel is violating international human rights law by killing civilians.

* And this June the United Nations itself investigated the Netanyahu government's actions and concluded that they have committed "crimes against humanity of extermination, gender persecution targeting Palestinian men and boys, murder, forcible transfer, and torture and inhuman and cruel treatment."

**And yet the Naperville City Council has yet to act.**
I close with wisdom from Nelson Mandela, a man who suffered in an apartheid South Africa prison for 27 years, only for his calls for justice. He admonished in 1997,
"But we know too well that our freedom is incomplete without the freedom of the Palestinians. These Palestinian and Israeli campaigners for peace know that security for any nation is not abstract; neither is it exclusive. We must make our voices heard calling for stronger action by world bodies as well as those states that have the power."
This Juneteenth, I once again call on the Naperville City Council to embrace your power, heed the call of justice and act for peace and security. Divest from war crimes. Divest from genocide. Let the future attest that Naperville stood on the right side of history. Thank you.

Stop. *Record scratch. Freeze frame.*
You may be wondering how this girl:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240620-1-t1&t=2&akid=1557%2E135344%2EefBLfH)
Ended up here:
[](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-june24.nyVfY7&refcode=em240620-1-t1&t=3&akid=1557%2E135344%2EefBLfH)
Serving my first of three tours in Iraq as a CIA analyst in Iraq, working to understand terrorist and militia groups that were targeting US forces and Iraqi civilians and plotting against the U.S.
It started on 9/11. One of the big moments that changed my life.
I was 24 years old, and I happened to be in New York City on my second day of grad school. By the time the dust had settled, I knew that I wanted to go into national security and protect my country.
Several months later, the CIA came to campus and my favorite professor encouraged me to hear what they had to say. Not wanting to disappoint him, I went. I applied, got the job, and after a lengthy background check, I started in Langley as an analyst.
It wasn’t long before I found myself in Iraq, my first of three deployments.
Going from the national security world to politics was a major culture shock. For 16 years, I didn’t talk publicly about my work—when I posted on Facebook that I was thinking about running for Congress, people asked me if I’d been hacked. One thing I definitely hadn’t done was ask people for money.
To be upfront: Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. When you're running to win a seat in a swing state like Michigan, you can't take anything for granted.
And we have a critical FEC fundraising deadline coming up in just a few days I need your help with.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Sharing my story with you

body:
Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.
#

Friends -
Thirteen years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240620-1-30&t=1&akid=8349%2E3935704%2ElEfSDI)
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240620-1-30&t=2&akid=8349%2E3935704%2ElEfSDI)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-june24.gd3XnS&refcode=em240620-1-30&t=3&akid=8349%2E3935704%2ElEfSDI)
I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting—or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day—I know how hard it can be.
But friends, we can’t give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope.
At the end of this month, GIFFORDS PAC is facing its June FEC fundraising deadline. Our quarterly fundraising deadlines are a critical test for the gun safety movement, as both adversaries and allies will be looking to see if we have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions this November.

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
joined the Morgan Ortagus Show
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69253&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61712> on Sirius XM Patriot on Sunday.

During the interview, Dahlstrom spoke about her campaign to unseat
Congresswoman Mary Peltola, her recent opinion piece on her trip to the
southern border in crisis, Russian warships in Cuba, and more.
Dahlstrom noted the potential food shortage facing America from farmers
being forced to destroy crops contaminated by illegal immigrants and
how America's foreign policy under Joe Biden and Mary Peltola are
emboldening our adversaries.

"I have the backing of Republican leaders across the state and country.
Our Governor Mike Dunleavy has endorsed me as well as Speaker Johnson
and Elise Stefanik. And also endorsements from the late Don Young's
wife Anne Young, which I'm thrilled to have," Lt. Governor Nancy
Dahlstrom said. "But if you go through Alaska, you'll learn that the
majority of Alaskans agree that Mary Peltola needs to go. We've seen
[the] damages that she and Joe Biden have caused by mismanaging our
nation."

"We know and we feel that our economy is in shambles, our southern
border is wide open, funneling fentanyl into our community. And I know
from having seen firsthand on the trip. to Yuma, Arizona, watching
these people literally enter our country illegally and our border
agents standing there having to act as social workers was hard to
watch," Lt. Governor Dahlstrom continued.

# The Message is Clear
---
| Hi Peter,
Patti Hewitt believes in the **strength of Coastal Georgia’s** **hardworking families** and **resilient communities**. Her campaign is all about putting the power back in your hands and ensuring that our **community thrives**.
Here’s how:
**What Makes Families Stronger:**
* Universal childcare to support working parents.
* Accessible early education for a great start in life.
* Addressing high maternal mortality rates to foster healthy mothers and babies.
* Supporting workers’ rights and fair wages to build a robust local economy.

**What Will Make Our Communities Stronger:**
* Strong public schools that provide quality education for all children.
* Healthcare privacy, accessibility, and affordability to keep our families healthy.
* Reducing regulatory burdens for small businesses to foster local entrepreneurship.
* Fair representation and democracy for all to ensure every voice is heard.

By **uniting Coastal Georgia** , Patti is committed to putting **families first** and **empowering our communities**. Your support is crucial in making this vision a reality. Share this message with your circle and let’s work together for a brighter future.
Thank you for being a part of this journey.

| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T19dea72c-b78e-4a7d-ab14-dbb35d063728/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8d1a0e86-0b17-42fd-a89d-9949b7d0f7f5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

**Thank you** for your commitment to our nation, and to our shared conservative values.

_Because of our members_ , Judicial Watch is America's indispensable, independent watchdog in Washington.

_Because of our members_ , we have _successfully cleaned over 4.5 million names off voter rolls around the country_...

_Because of our members_ , we are suing **Illinois** over its failure to clean its voter rolls, we are suing **California** over its failure to honor its previous settlement with us, and we are also suing **Illinois** and **Mississippi** over their irresponsible laws that permit ballots received days and even weeks after Election Day to be counted...

_Because of our members_ , we are 5 _exposing_ the widespread weaponization of federal agencies and the misuse of prosecutorial power by the Biden administration and politicized prosecutors targeting conservatives and other political opponents, including Donald Trump...

_Because of our members_ , we are suing **Evanston, Illinois** over its $20 million radical woke reparations program that is nothing more than a ploy to redistribute tax dollars to individuals based on race and that violates the sacred American principle of _equal protection under the law_...

_Because of our members_ , we are leading the legal charge to uncover massive Biden family corruption...

...while every day we are also doing the vital work of using the legal system and the courts to force the release of public documents that "we the people" have a right to see!

**_In short, thanks to our members we are fighting doggedly and persistently for the rule of law and for accountability in government_!**

Greetings!
This year's election is about nothing less than saving America and the principles it was founded upon. That's why we're tracking each state's primary elections and highlighting the pro-family champions who win their races.
Last night several candidates won their elections, moving them one step closer to protecting the American family and the rights of parents.
Here is what you need to know from Tuesday's primaries:

Virginia Senate Pro-family Hung Cao will face Sen. Tim Kaine in a massively important race.
Control of the Senate is vitally important to protecting American families, and Virginia has continued to trend from being a blue state to a toss-up for both the Senate race and the presidential election. Hung Cao won yesterday's primary to become the Republican nominee for Senate in Virginia. He will face off against incumbent Sen. Tim Kaine.
In 2023, Sen. Kaine helped Senate Democrats reintroduce the incredibly dangerous Equality Act. This legislation would cement the Left's gender ideology into law, allowing men to compete in women's sports and giving men access to women's private spaces like locker rooms and rest rooms. Hung Cao will fight against the woke, anti-family agenda of Senate Democrats and protect American families!
Oklahoma Congressional Congressman Kevin Hern wins big in Oklahoma's 1st district!
Hern is the chair of the Republican Study Committee and is a great ally in the House. APPworked extensively with the RSC under former chairman Rep. Jim Banks, and we look forward to continuing that work with the new chairman Rep. Hern to protect American families.
Oklahoma Congressional Congressman Tom Cole wins big in Oklahoma's 4th district!
Rep. Cole is the new chair of the House Appropriations Committee and can be an important ally in APP's efforts to remove woke gender ideology from federal funding and promote age verification for adult sites at the national level.

---
Thank you,
Terry Schilling President American Principles Project

| | Did you hear the news? **Last month, I requested $42 million for fifteen local projects in the 2025 spending bill through the House's Community Project Funding requests system.** For context, we were able to secure $19.3 million for projects in this year's spending package — $42,399,656 would be a great addition! Before we dive into the specifics of these projects, I want to underscore that this is work I am deeply passionate about. Bringing funding like this back to communities in Northwest Washington will make a real impact on our daily lives. [**Can you chip in $3 to my re-election campaign before our end-of-quarter fundraising deadline this month and help me continue this work?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87242668/480525132/1596212816?refcode=2024-06-20-cfp&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=0e373e51-102f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTM3M2U1MS0xMDJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kePVc6BZFRYvocT5r9kyKyA1EOw9T0KdU0Nu3WnVacY=) [Donate Now](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87242670/480525133/1596212816?refcode=2024-06-20-cfp&recurring=&amount=3&amounts=10,30,50,100,200&refcode2=0e373e51-102f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZTM3M2U1MS0xMDJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kePVc6BZFRYvocT5r9kyKyA1EOw9T0KdU0Nu3WnVacY=) **Here is an overview of these projects and a quick synopsis of how they will allow us to reinvest in more sustainable infrastructure, improve community services, and accelerate education and workforce development:** **$16,238,000** for investments in sustainable infrastructure:
* **Everett** : $5,040,000 requested for the Holly Roundabout project to design and construct a roundabout at 100 Street and Holly Drive;
* **Lynden** : $3,088,000 to support the design and construction of the Pepin Parkway Bridge;
* **Skagit** : $3,000,000 to support the construction of Transit's Maintenance Operations and Administration Facility;
* **Community Transit** : $3,000,000 to purchase three battery-electric buses with chargers to replace diesel buses that are beyond their expected useful life;
* **Oak Harbor** : $450,000 to improve pedestrian access and make all sidewalks and parking areas ADA-compliant at The Center at Oak Harbor;
* **Island County** : $2,800,000 to build a new solid waste transfer station to make the county's waste management processes cheaper and more efficient, and mitigate impacts to public health, safety, and the environment; and
* **Port of Edmonds** : $1,860,000 for a reconstruction of the North Portwalk and Seawall to build a public waterfront plaza and support electrical upgrades.

**$15,681,335** for investments in community services:
* **Lummi Nation** : $10,430,485 for the Lummi Indian Business Council's Lummi Detox Center, which will feature a stabilization and withdrawal management facility, culturally attuned care and aftercare, treatment, and family support for Tribal members impacted by the opioid crisis;
* **Edmonds** : $2,200,000 to improve Edmonds Food Bank space to include a commercial kitchen, an urban garden, and community spaces;
* **Bellingham** : $2,000,000 to renovate the Bellingham Central Library including updated windows, entrances, and a refreshed reading plaza;
* **Whatcom County:** $919,600 to renovate Whatcom County's Domestic Violence and Sexual Assault Services Douglas Building to better serve survivors; and
* **Orcas Island** : $131,250 to replace the failing roof on the Orcas Senior Center to ensure seniors continue to access services.

**$7,480,321** for investments in education and workforce development:
* **Edmonds** : $3,755,447 to establish a community center featuring a cultural retention and arts center, vocational school, commercial kitchen, deli-specialty store, and child care at the Edmonds College and Latino Educational Training Institute's Incubator for Family Success;
* **Edmonds** : $2,234,474 to retrofit fluorescent lighting at Meadowdale High, Edmonds-Woodway High, and Meadowdale Middle schools with LED lighting which will reduce energy usage by 30 percent; and
* **Bellingham** : $1,490,400 to support Western Washington University's acquisition of a new research vessel for WWU marine and coastal science educational and research activities.

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Jacky Rosen is running for reelection to the Senate and needs our help. I hope you’ll read the message from her below and consider [**splitting a donation between Jacky's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rosen.ErO1Hf&refcode=em240620-1-30&t=1&akid=5785%2E6688874%2ELZS34S)

Hey Derek, this is Lexi, Adam’s daughter!
My dad has a big day coming up (and this time, I’m not talking about a campaign fundraising deadline — though those are important too!).
**My dad’s birthday is on Saturday!**
[**His campaign team and I put together a digital card to collect signatures from his most loyal grassroots supporters, and it would mean a lot if you could sign today.**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20240620-adambirthday.Wc0Gnv&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240620_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6754%2E5257348%2E8Iv-LQ)
[SIGN THE CARD 🎂](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1024?c0=engagement-20240620-adambirthday.n0mB3S&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240620_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=6754%2E5257348%2E8Iv-LQ)
---
As you can probably imagine, my dad is a pretty busy guy.
Between his work in the House, service on the House Judiciary Committee, meeting with Californians as he runs for Senate, and going on the news to talk about his work holding Donald Trump accountable for his bad behavior — that’s a lot of hard work!
But he _loves_ it, Derek. Nothing means more to my dad than making a real difference in people’s lives, whether that’s fighting to secure affordable healthcare, increasing funding for housing, or protecting our rights and freedoms.
I admire my dad’s work ethic and deep commitment to our democracy — but as his daughter, it’s also my job to make sure he kicks back and relaxes a little bit on his birthday!
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20240620-adambirthday.Wc0Gnv&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240620_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=6754%2E5257348%2E8Iv-LQ)
_Should I get us these hats from my first birthday party? 🥳_
Derek, my dad appreciates you and this team so much. He tells me all the time how grateful he is to have such an amazing group of people backing him up day after day.
[**So it would certainly mean a lot to him (and to me, too!) if you signed his birthday card. Can you add your name today?**](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=engagement-20240620-adambirthday.Wc0Gnv&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240620_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=7&akid=6754%2E5257348%2E8Iv-LQ)

xx Lexi

body:
I’m Hill, and this is my story.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1273%2E62735%2EGzZGtY)
Hey Peter,
In a minute I’d like to reintroduce myself and share my story, but first: **[My campaign has a critical end-of-quarter deadline coming up in ten days, and _every_ dollar is critical to our success. Will you rush any amount — no matter how small — to hit our goal before the deadline?](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1734?t=2&akid=1273%2E62735%2EGzZGtY)**
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/812?t=3&akid=1273%2E62735%2EGzZGtY)
**[DONATE »](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1734?t=4&akid=1273%2E62735%2EGzZGtY)**
I've worn many hats throughout my life, from lawyer to union organizer, author to actor, and cancer survivor to single father. I’m a small business owner, too — I have a well-known coffee shop right here in Detroit. **But above all, I'm a servant leader driven by a passion for making life better for everyone around me.**
Growing up in the Midwest with two doctor parents, I learned early on the value of public service. It's a lesson that has stayed with me throughout my life, from my days at Harvard Law School to my time on the set of The Good Doctor. I've always believed that true leadership means putting the needs of the people above personal ambition, and I’ve committed myself to building a career that reflects those values.
That's why I was proud to serve on President Obama’s Cancer Panel. It's why I've written books to empower marginalized young people and established a foundation to help them achieve their dreams. It’s why I joined the UAW and SAG-AFTRA strikes last year to support their fight for better pay and working conditions.
**Now, I'm running for the U.S. Senate because I believe that the challenges facing our nation demand new, dynamic leadership — not the same bought-and-paid-for politicians who let us down year after year.** We need responsive leaders who will put public service over personal gain, fight for our most urgent priorities, and embody the authentic representation that every Michigander deserves.
But I can't do it alone. And since I’m not taking a cent of corporate PAC money, I need your help to build a grassroots movement that puts the power back in the hands of the people.
**[My campaign’s critical end-of-quarter deadline is coming up in ten days, Peter. Please, chip in $5 — or anything that works for you — to reach my campaign’s $25,000 fundraising goal by the midnight deadline on June 30th.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1734?t=6&akid=1273%2E62735%2EGzZGtY)**

subject: Big Shift in PA Politics
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voice of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

The segment focused on how women are reshaping the Pennsylvania politics landscape. PA Treasurer Stacy Garrity and her Democratic challenger Erin McClelland joined us to share their views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Democratic Candidate for PA Treasurer Erin McClelland** clarified that a computer error, later resolved with the Department of State, led to the reported dispute around her campaign finance filings. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=715c1e76ee&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Treasurer of the Commonwealth Stacy Garrity** explained that the state's investment in Israeli bonds after the October 7th attack is not only an act of solidarity, but also of fiscal strategy. These investments started in the 1990s and have been profitable due to their reliability and above-market returns. [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=31727e7acd&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Elections_
* In the months after Roe v. Wade was overturned, **52% of new voters were women, while only 46% were men**. Normally, the split is about equal. [[L2 Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=f7fabe5d55&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Sentiment_
* **16% of Pennsylvanians surveyed are "less likely" to support Trump following his felony conviction.** 47% would "never support," and 36% would "support regardless."** **[[L2 Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=6172130537&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Policy_
* **Support for school funding, teachers' unions, and common core education standards is generally similar across party lines**. Socioeconomic status and parenthood make the most difference in attitudes on these issues, not party. [[L2 Data](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=344810dcb0&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
Participants shared their experiences running for local office and discussed the challenges of being a woman in politics in this week's _Voices of Reason_ roundtable segment.
|
* * *
---
| **Coming Up...**
---
|
#### Join the Voices of Reason team next Monday (June 24) at the Harrisburg Rotunda where we will record our signature podcast
---
| Don’t miss out on interviews with some of Harrisburg's familiar faces as we discuss a proposal to eliminate fees on the sales tax components of purchases, the debate over having open primaries in Pennsylvania, and changing how the state treats Net Operating Losses.
---
|
#### In Case You Missed It
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=99e3a58011&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=87b6d881f2&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d47a252194&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3c273a5f79&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7e96b6ac76&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

The New York Young Republican Club is proud to endorse Dr. Michael Goldstein for Connecticut's Fourth Congressional District. With his plethora of experience fighting for the American people over a period of decades, Dr. Goldstein has shown the tenacity, credentials, perseverance, and conservative principles required to be a powerful, honorable, and selfless representative for the people of Connecticut.
Dr. Goldstein is a Board-Certified Physician of over forty years. He served as the President of the New York County Medical Society for two terms and still serves as a Board Member. For over four decades, Dr. Goldstein has been on the _front lines_ of the medical industry, fighting for his patients and saving thousands of lives.
Beyond his medical experience, Dr. Goldstein has worked numerous blue-collar jobs, is also a lawyer, and currently serves as an elected City Councilman at the Greenwich Representative Town Meeting. He has published numerous articles in health law journals and is a strong proponent of healthcare reform that puts Americans and their healthcare needs first.
Dr. Goldstein has made it very clear that the American people and their healthcare needs are at the crux of his medical and legal training and his extensive grassroots activism. A great example is that, as an active member of the Board of Managers of the SUNY Downstate College of Medicine Alumni Association, Dr. Goldstein has worked to give scholarships and grants to economically-disadvantaged medical students, easing their financial burdens and providing them the opportunity to fulfill their dreams.
The New York Young Republican Club strongly believes that Dr. Goldstein will leverage his vast experience in the healthcare activism field to fight the Radical Left's agenda in Congress. His common-sense, America-First approach will focus on shrinking government, fighting corruption at the core of our institutions, reducing healthcare costs and administrative burdens, protecting our freedoms, championing pro-American healthcare legislation, empowering small business growth, and eradicating anti-semitism.
Dr. Goldstein recently received the endorsement of the Medical Society of the State of New York (MSSNY). This is the first time in recent history that the MSSNY has endorsed a candidate that is not an incumbent, and the MSSNY stated that "physicians need more physicians in Congress to represent their interests."
As we approach the most pivotal election in recent memory, we recognize that Connecticut, just like every state in this country, requires strong Republican, conservative, America-First candidates who are prepared to protect the American people from the Left's years-long plan to destroy this country. The New York Young Republican Club believes Dr. Goldstein is one such candidate well-equipped to put the state of Connecticut back on track, and encourages all registered Republicans to vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein in Connecticut's primary on August 13th. Please note that Early Voting will take place August 5th through August 11th.

| Dear Friend,

**American values are under constant attack.** Young people are taught to believe the United States is always in the wrong. College campuses are dominated by the radical left.
---
|
---
| I’m an immigrant to the United States who has seen firsthand what makes America exceptional. I find it deeply disturbing that so many young Americans grow up encouraged to think badly about their own country.

**As a father, I’m determined that my daughter grows up appreciating America the way that I do.**

That’s why I’ve gone and done something a little different, writing a children’s book “ _What Makes America Special_ ”.
---
| |

Beautifully illustrated by Nicholas Jackson, it contains six key truths about America that every child ought to know (and which I worry aren’t being taught!)

**__If we don’t teach our children the truth about America, TikTok and progressive professors will fill young minds with ‘woke’ ideology.__**

**_The best antidote to ‘woke’ ideas is to teach the American story. _**

We must take responsibility to teach our children truths about their country that will shape their views for life.

Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to receive this CONSERVATIVE NEWS ALERT from Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) .

Embattled IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy Resigns Effective July 19, Blames Rise of "Grassroots," Leaves Behind a Record of Massive GOP Losses (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review
On Wednesday, Illinois Republican Party Chairman Don Tracy submitted his resignation as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the powerful “grassroots,” party infighting and the recent removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman.

Tracy also blamed the rise of the “grassroots,” writing, “Like Vince Kolber, my friend and former Finance Committee Chair, I am also concerned about the current infatuation of some members of the SCC, few as they are, with certain individuals they call “grass roots” leaders.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

For the last two years, this publication has consistently called on Tracy to resign. And on November 21, 2022, just weeks after massive and widespread GOP losses during the midterm election, IR editor-in-chief Mark Vargas wrote an opinion piece titled, “It’s Time for Don Tracy to Resign, Now,” writing (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2022/11/vargas-its-time-for-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-to-resign-now.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) ,

“It’s also going to take new Illinois GOP leadership – and it is why I am calling on IL GOP Chairman Don Tracy to resign.

Resign Now.

The people of Illinois need to know that the GOP is serious about rebuilding and putting the best team in place to win.

If Don Tracy can take credit for victories, then he most certainly can take responsibility for losses. And the losses were many.”

Since November of 2022, this publication has published dozens of
articles (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/tag/don-tracy?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) critical of Tracy and calling on him to resign. And last June, 30 organizations representing over 80,000 conservative grassroots (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/06/ir-exclusive-30-organizations-across-illinois-representing-over-80000-grassroots-activists-sign-an-open-letter-of-no-confidence-in-il-gop-chair-don-tracys-leadership.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) activists from across the state, signed an open letter and shared exclusively with this publication, calling on the Illinois Republican State Central Committee to remove Don Tracy as chairman of the state party in a motion of “No Confidence.” In the letter, the grassroots wrote,

“The state of the Illinois Republican Party is not good. Under chairman Don Tracy’s leadership, fundraising is a struggle, party infighting has made its way into the pages of the Chicago Tribune, Politico and Crain’s Chicago Business – and more importantly, the conservative grassroots base – the heart, soul and backbone of the Illinois Republican Party, feels ignored – and their volunteer efforts minimized.”

https://youtu.be/tTpct-8Z8ls?si=wYAjvt1KytwjZd0d&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=6183c4974f-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

America is under attack from Socialists trying to implement their radical policies, Conservative censorship, and reckless overspending. This will destroy our country.

| [**STOP BIG GOVERNMENT CONTROL**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=e2279a3aa05d494da28e5a5ff07721f7&_e=dPTN68tVKAUtpvAh_C58y8e_SZFhOp-AmMfqc_8z4lAgjkyDN5aM7jhua6jo4OfQrGtX02Ggd5Sw4jNUYTVwucgbdtPxaQT3nZap1G4IofwH1Z-63ymLbJZ46TzxBk01_JEBCJG0qZ3WsiQ2_OPmkjq748ZeoC-wXtYI8p8LDZX50k9LNCzrEOgAFWfz4qcXTfdW9CivJd1KZ5T1HJvmEGpo3kXbcJnpovEE5YoTe8HqBv-uzKrgrkL64UpgSy6VLTErXDPS9LZIe5IZ5J86hnLQxFudX84tFDUNTGDZKN7XuTvqO2lXPgVNuAt-7peSx9MNB9fiaK_SaaI3DslKG9dmYKSehVrg-PEUMGoWMzIL6EHkLx2QWlAcBxoo5QUB1qXfY3R0JYsT6f_yDCc27_I7WUpoXER0hCvOUYSy439dILLGf1CNGCFTClAXGm9a)

**This is how Socialism will destroy America:**

* Abolish private property
* Open our borders to gain more radicals
* Raise taxes
* Restrict personal liberty
* Increase government mandates

Let me tell you a little bit about myself.... I’m a retired Navy CAPT who spent 25 years fighting for our country in some of the most dangerous battlegrounds in the world. My family and I came to America when I was just four years old after my father was put on a kill list in Communist Vietnam. If it wasn’t for America, I probably wouldn’t be alive today. I owe my life to this country - so I paid her back by attending the Naval Academy after graduating high school and dedicating my career to serving America. I served in Iraq, Afghanistan, and Somalia where I defused IEDs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces. I performed some of the most dangerous dives in the military all around the world. It wasn’t easy, and there were many times where my life flashed before my eyes. But it was worth it, because I was protecting this country so the next generation could have the same opportunities that I did. I wanted to share with you some of the horror stories that have happened as a result of a porous and open Southern Border. These tragedies fall at the feet of Joe Biden and his Liberal cronies, who support leaving the Southern Border WIDE OPEN.

All of these horrific incidents could have been prevented with Republican leadership in Congress and the White House...

_**Laken Riley**_

Laken Riley's story took the headlines on all major media outlets in 2024 after she was viciously attacked, almost raped, and killed by an illegal immigrant out of Venezuela. The monster who took her life visited Laken's university in the morning and spied on students and potential victims. Later that day, he stalked and killed Laken, who was a 22-year-old nursing student at the University of Georgia with her entire life ahead of her.

In response to the murder, President Biden downplayed the story and said, "Laken Riley, an innocent young woman who was killed by an illegal. That's right, but how many thousands of people are killed by legals?"

_**Kate Steinle**_

Kate Steinle was taking a walk with her father and friend on Pier 14 in San Francisco in July 2015 when she was suddenly shot and collapsed into her father's arms. Her killer was an illegal immigrant from Mexico who had been released from prison three months prior despite a request by federal immigration authorities to detain him for deportation. Because San Francisco is a sanctuary city, local law enforcement was barred from cooperating with federal immigration authorities.

When the killer was tried in court, he was acquitted of the murder charges and only was found guilty of possession of an illegal firearm, which he stole from a federal ranger a week earlier. He was deported shortly thereafter, but not soon enough for Kate Steinle.

_**Terry and Brenda Aultman**_

Terry and Brenda Aultman were brutally stabbed to death with their throats slashed as they rode their bikes home together from Bike Week in Daytona Beach, Florida, in 2022. The killer was a mentally competent illegal immigrant out of Haiti. Daytona Beach Police Department Chief Jakari Young said the slaying was "probably one of the most vicious and gruesome incidents that I've witnessed in my 20 years."

The killer was a known criminal who had multiple prior drug charges in Orange County, but the State Attorney dropped the charges in 2020 for unknown reasons. The Aultmans suffered at the hands of an illegal immigrant who should not have been in our country but was thanks to a combination of an open border and Liberal State Attorneys who side with Illegals over U.S. citizens.

_**Massachusetts Child Raped**_

In early 2024, an illegal immigrant out of Columbia was arrested in Lynn, Massachusetts, for raping a minor over 14 years old. ACROSS THE COMMONWEALTH
VOTE TODAY! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/Make%20A%20Plan%20To%20Vote.png]
You can vote for November's elections NOW! Vote at your Registrar's office during business hours. Saturday early voting is available October 28th and November 4th. Learn More [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
Find your local Registrar's office here: https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup [https://vote.elections.virginia.gov/VoterInformation/PublicContactLookup]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/VWCC.jpeg] 15 years of the Community College Access Program at VWCC
Learn More [https://www.wdbj7.com/2023/09/26/virginia-western-celebrates-15th-anniversary-ccap-program/] CCAP is a successful public/private partnership that pays the cost of tuition for three years at Virginia Western Community College if a qualified student does not have sufficient financial aid to pay tuition costs.
This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!
CANDIDATE SPOTLIGHT
https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.
She is a champion for education, public safety and mental health. As your next Delegate for the 89th District, she will continue to fight and vote for meaningful policies and legislation to support the needs of the district. At the state level, she will be positioned to write and sponsor bills and laws to benefit the schools and communities in the 89th District and throughout the commonwealth.

[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/lily%20canvass.png]
Canvass for Lily Franklin!
On Sundays, join Team Lily at the South County Library Parking Lot from 12 - 12:30 pm for a Roanoke canvassing event!
Bring your walking shoes, a charged cell phone, and water. When you arrive to their launch location you will receive a brief training and literature before being sent out to turf. Questions? Email Beth at egunter3@gmail.com [egunter3@gmail.com] or call 540-353-3645.
South County Library Parking Lot, 6303 Merriman Rd, Roanoke, VA 24018

Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Join Roanoke Young Dems! [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93159/images/RYD.png]

name: Scott Fitzgerald
subject: Let's unite on this!
body:
| | | I recently returned from the border, and do you know what ticks me off? That Democrats are _**actively**_ undermining our border security. We can't win the border battle like this, Peter. For example, illegal immigration has decreased in Republican lead Texas while increasing in Democrat lead California... Because Texas took action when the federal government wouldn't, a California border town saw an **eye-popping 85 PERCENT rise in the month of February!** Illegal immigrants are simply skipping Texas and walking in through California then disappearing into our country. It's a national problem that demands a national solution. Congress can't just keep kicking the can down the road because we disagree. Americans deserve a unified government on our most sacred duty, protecting our homeland! _**[_**Will you contribute $10 to help me shine a light on the severity of this problem and build a border coalition to get the job done?**_](https://links.iterable.com/u/click?_t=eb238f2f76ef45d9874febb01484fd35&_m=49e9fba9b772461b85409e60061cf755&_e=jOCSQ2J4r1VI9H9UARWgQlIoRo7TknvIVDvdNZPHYwH-OdZResLRdg0lgmhoAT4BB8vA4X5JTZLouTPPdBiiPxAqLGTQry8u70WtsbNEQ9pVlu31Hvdc951w5-ZFq9uUlB1ONCC3aoLA9YXcuC1HTLjhPJEXR-wv26_2lzc-lIoOHIlJxU2trElIY3npcmAcLFgHozLrmm7U9vpPH4hEHo-paOoo_6jXkI1v7PT4TUqWODVkvvhToBeAOIlMBaXhkSgVlNYu34_BSYSRYqOiPHloqYu7IGd0kuA25tFi09G2gE-JIEF4PY14ZfRUGShfuK5NnbUPnB3vrztiO4fQvJOKfOIp2r2nBXPv3XoqeZKdX9GLFOMEMgZivnc5i7rZ)**_ Thanks for being beside me in this fight. Thanks for being beside me in this fight. Sincerely,Congressman Scott Fitzgerald | | [I'm With You, Scott! [ CONTRIBUTE $10 ]]() | | | | | | ---|--- | |

| Dear Fellow Patriot,

It saddens me to see that our education system has been taken over by radicals who push insane political ideologies like CRT, DEI, transgenderism and more on our poor children.

To me, it's common sense that school curriculum needs to be focused on the priority of teaching kids basic subjects such as reading, math, and civics.

How did that basic knowledge seem to get conveniently lost over the years?

You and I know that when it comes to a child's education and health, as well as their moral and religious upbringing, parents are primarily responsible.

That's why I believe parents have the right to steer their children's education, especially when it comes to sensitive subjects and that schools should resist the incorporation of non-academic subjects that fall within the family's purview.

And if you agree with me, then I invite you to use the link below to sign the pledge today.

body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Watching the Phillies trounce the Padres at Citizens Bank Park with my parents on Monday was the best Father’s Day gift.

My father’s childhood experiences playing cricket in India led him to follow baseball and become an avid Phillies fan. He passed on his love for the game to me and my brother. Decades after taking in games in Veterans Stadium’s $1 seats, spending another summer evening at the park together was pure joy.

https://www.inquirer.com/columnists/attytood/ro-khanna-phillies-greedflation-disinformation-20240618.html [https://www.inquirer.com/columnists/attytood/ro-khanna-phillies-greedflation-disinformation-20240618.html]

READ: “Is this Phillies fan the future of the Democrats?” [https://www.inquirer.com/columnists/attytood/ro-khanna-phillies-greedflation-disinformation-20240618.html]

When Alec Bohm blasted a 3-run homer in the 5th inning, everyone jumped to their feet and started high-fiving. That’s one of my favorite parts about baseball. It’s not just the joy of the game but a real community that brings people together from all walks of life.

My friend Will Bunch from the Philadelphia Inquirer joined us for the game. We talked about baseball, cricket, the upcoming election, and what it will take for Biden to win a second term.

I hope you take 5 minutes to read Will’s piece about our talk in The Philadelphia Inquirer . [https://www.inquirer.com/columnists/attytood/ro-khanna-phillies-greedflation-disinformation-20240618.html] You can text me at (650) 999-9610 to let me know what you think.

Thank you for your activism and all that you do.

In solidarity,
Ro

| | Today is the first day of summer, and we can feel the temperatures heating up – with some parts of the country already seeing temperatures over 100 degrees and this week's heat dome in the Midwest and Northeast setting records for dangerous, extreme heat. These hotter summers are a clear signal that we are not doing enough to address climate chaos. **Scientists keep sounding the alarm as the Earth's temperature continues to rise due to the endless burning of fossil fuels.** Across the country, we see and struggle with the effects of climate chaos daily. Wildfire smoke blankets our communities with air pollution, extreme drought threatens our food supply, and intensifying storms leave behind record-level flooding and damage. **_The bottom line is we can't keep living like this._** For our sake and for the sake of future generations, we need Climate Champions in Congress – leaders willing to take big, bold action to stop polluters and tackle the climate crisis. We need leaders who are unafraid to take on Republicans who deny the effects of climate change, give tax breaks and preferential policies to Big Oil, Big Coal, the Koch network and its right-wing billionaires, and the corporations that pollute our air, land, and water. These hotter summers are a clear signal that we are not doing enough to address climate chaos. Scientists keep sounding the alarm as the Earth's temperature continues to rise due to the endless burning of fossil fuels. Across the country, we see and struggle with the effects of climate chaos daily. Wildfire smoke blankets our communities with air pollution, extreme drought threatens our food supply, and intensifying storms leave behind record-level flooding and damage. The bottom line is we can't keep living like this. For our sake and for the sake of future generations, we need Climate Champions in Congress – leaders willing to take big, bold action to stop polluters and tackle the climate crisis. We need leaders who are unafraid to take on Republicans who deny the effects of climate change, give tax breaks and preferential policies to Big Oil, Big Coal, the Koch network and its right-wing billionaires, and the corporations that pollute our air, land, and water. = = Onward! # [Sign: Support lawsuits fighting Louisiana’s new law mandating display of Ten Commandments in classrooms >> ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9ae68d26-8d8b-432a-8954-a96d9e1c6003/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Louisiana's Republican Governor Jeff Landry just signed a law requiring the Ten Commandments be displayed in every classroom in the state. This is dangerous and unconstitutional. We do not live in a theocracy – and the founders were very clear about the need for separation of church and state! We cannot stand by and let the state push a specific religion in public schools. Thankfully, civil rights groups including the ACLU immediately fought back, filing lawsuits against the bill. We need to show our support for these lawsuits and send a message loud and clear across the country that laws like this one will not stand. [**Sign your name to join us in supporting the lawsuits fighting back against Louisiana's law mandating display of the Ten Commandments in classrooms >> **](https://default.salsalabs.org/T15a3c943-aa28-4955-9b27-b368eea5db07/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We’re less than six full months into 2024 and have already seen 230 mass shootings in this country. At this current pace, more than 1,000 teenagers will be killed by gun violence for the fifth straight year. Yet this court’s ruling to reverse the ban on bump stocks – in effect, deciding the _Trump Administration_ was too tough on gun safety – will only put more vulnerable people at risk.

The bottom line is we have work to do at the federal level to save lives. That includes universal background checks, permit-to-purchase, safe storage, and an outright ban on assault tools like bump stocks. And in Congress, I will fight to ensure each of those efforts is victorious.

subject: BS abortion bans, and how you can help

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38922%2E3422442%2E8CcJPO)
Derek,
This is some BS: **the state of Missouri has a total abortion ban** —without exceptions for rape and incest.
**[Can you make a $5 contribution right now that will be split between the campaign dedicated to ending this ban, Missourians for Constitutional Freedom, and my organization, Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240620-mo?refcode=em20240620-38922&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38922_3422442_8CcJPO&akid=38922%2E3422442%2E8CcJPO)**
For nearly two years since the _Dobbs_ decision, Misourians have been living under a total abortion ban. You see, politicians there had passed trigger laws, designed to ban abortion if the Supreme Court ever overturned _Roe._
Like you probably do, I still remember where I was when the news broke that _Roe_ would be overturned. I was making pasta for a sick kid after a long day. I thought to myself, _how can any politician think they are equipped to make the deeply personal decision to become a parent for someone else?_
While I’m proud that Californians have voted to protect access to abortion, **we can’t accept abortion only being allowed in some states as “good enough.”**
That’s why I’m asking you to support Missourians for Constitutional Freedom. Because of their work to get this amendment on the ballot, **Missourians will have the chance to end the state’s cruel abortion ban.** **[Anti-abortion groups will throw everything they can at this, and your support is critical.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240620-mo?refcode=em20240620-38922&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38922_3422442_8CcJPO&akid=38922%2E3422442%2E8CcJPO)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240620-mo?refcode=em20240620-38922&refcode2=38922_3422442_8CcJPO&akid=38922%2E3422442%2E8CcJPO)
Just like in Kansas, Kentucky, and Ohio—I know that when voters have the chance to make their voices heard, they’ll stand up to career politicians who have taken away their freedom.
Thanks for supporting this fight,
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240620-38922&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38922_3422442_8CcJPO&akid=38922%2E3422442%2E8CcJPO)**

Why does this matter? Because Ruben is showing us who he is. He'll take those checks and run ads saying he's a "moderate", but at his heart, he's an out of touch coastal elite trying to fool hardworking Arizonans.

**[Chip in to help me fight back](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=8b6a38fbd8e641979ae3614c00c08f03&_e=Pj2_2zI201gDAfbsvi9R5h5eSBUhJaxzLAJFkx7_oZN5wOPXb0-1lvzwb44jdUjWz6P50_diLwczGi0angDBgLISFNJKLXjVBdMXocl8LU8JNOttsj5b78GDKhqdRAiII0xRgO4hHFZF-oGRiorbqNPq0uYikZ8S-rsgLuXjWW7YGsSEN50AF7FdqEvnqUVIk88iuYJUlYJAiuV33ramFBfuv92I-p1lsmDOF-WygMO3nCSN32F2auAvcpAHlEoT7MdTWlGK-yWoOOQo-ZcJQbgjlb5QxWgHxrWH8dmsP2IFM5nwmbzGFe1miyo9UwlkK29ZY3AkrvlxnL2kSsHXMzdPn9PwdnXpxySo09KeUCeAr-sMP_WdoHhOkzDwWcAP4uuces1bvWBxpSLNf13MZw%3D%3D).**

Ruben isn't running to represent Arizona. He's running to represent his liberal mega-donors. He's already spending millions of dollars against me, and thanks to his Hollywood friends, you can bet the attacks will keep on coming.

body:
I’m here today only because of the kindness of strangers who fought to open the door for those fleeing unthinkable circumstances. Others should have the same chance.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1200%2E791427%2EbZ4Ns-)
Friend,
Today is World Refugee Day.
I’m here today only because of the kindness of strangers who fought to open the door for those fleeing unthinkable circumstances, and I believe others should have the same chance.
In the spirit of recognizing the strength and courage of the millions of people worldwide who have been forcibly displaced by war, conflict, famine, disease, natural disasters, climate change, or any other reason, I hope you'll take a moment to read my op-ed in _The Atlantic_ below.
In solidarity,
Ilhan
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-june24.zT5set&refcode=em240620-1-1&t=2&akid=1200%2E791427%2EbZ4Ns-)

* * *
Open the Door Wider for Refugees
By Ilhan Omar
Of the many titles I hold — congresswoman, mother, sister, organizer — one represents a part of my identity that I hold particularly close to my heart: _refugee._
People frequently come up to me and share their own refugee stories. We immediately ask each other how long it has been since arriving in the United States. In my case, it’s been 29 years since my family and I were given a golden ticket to start a new life in America as refugees.
We escaped war in Somalia and found refuge at the Utange camp in Kenya. During my four years living in a refugee camp with little food or water, I saw the best and worst of humanity. I witnessed the joy of a mother welcoming a baby safely into the world, despite the odds stacked against her. I witnessed the death of friends and family members in a camp where malaria, dysentery, and respiratory diseases were rampant. I am grateful that I made it out alive. But I would not be here without the generosity of the Kenyan people, the resolute efforts of UN workers, the help of resettlement organizations such as Lutheran Immigration and Refugee Service, and the welcoming spirit of the American people who gave me and my family a second chance at life.
Right now, the world is facing an unprecedented displacement crisis, as conflicts and catastrophes in the Middle East, Africa, Latin America, and Asia displace tens of millions of people from their homes. I’m here today only because of the kindness of strangers who fought to open the door for those fleeing unthinkable circumstances. And that’s why today, as we observe World Refugee Day, I am calling on President Biden to raise the refugee admissions cap, and allow more to enter the United States.
Not long after taking office, the president raised the admissions cap to 125,000, an important step in the right direction. But that number is still too small. Even worse, we have routinely failed to meet the cap. President Biden has called the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program “a statement about who we are, and who we want to be.” I want us to be a country that lives up to our values of opening our arms during times of global catastrophe—both by raising the cap, and by ensuring that we actually admit the number of refugees it authorizes.
The horrific civil war in Sudan has displaced an estimated 10 million people, including almost 2 million who have fled to neighboring countries. Many of them have sought refuge in Ethiopia, which itself still has more than 1 million people forcibly displaced by the conflict and atrocities in Tigray. More than 1 million Rohingya are living in Bangladesh within a refugee camp in Cox’s Bazar that has become a hotbed for forced recruitment of child soldiers and other human-rights violations. Massive numbers of people have fled wars in Syria and Ukraine, and economic and security collapses in Venezuela and Haiti. Global strife, economic uncertainty, and the climate crisis seem likely to fuel even higher levels of forced migration in the years ahead.
The systems in place, both in the U.S. and at the international level, are clearly inadequate to meet the scale of the displacement we are seeing around the world. Not only is it crucial to raise the refugee admissions cap; we also need an international treaty for migration worldwide, like the Paris Agreement on climate change, except binding on its signatories. We must create a system that is based on the human rights of migrants; that is mindful of the disparate experiences that migrant women, children, and LGBTQ people face; and that recognizes that every country on Earth has its role to play in establishing a more just, efficient, and humane way for people to exercise their freedom of movement.
As we work toward that larger goal, the United States must work to improve its own system for handling refugees. People who make the gut-wrenching decision to flee their home to escape brutal violence, as my family did, do not pause to consider whether Title 42 will impede their ability to enter the U.S. They do not check to see what amendments are going to be offered in the House of Representatives, watch a little bit of a Senate floor debate, or read through press statements from the White House. They flee because they have to. They come to our borders because they have no other option. There is no level of cruelty and no number of condescending warnings placed on billboards in Guatemala or anywhere else that will prevent parents from protecting their family.
The Biden administration has shown creativity and flexibility in creating parole programs for Ukrainians, Haitians, Cubans, and Venezuelans. These are not perfect solutions, but they have been successful at reducing border encounters for people from those countries, and they have demonstrated that we have the ability to welcome people in large numbers through orderly and safe processes. We should do the same for Sudanese and Ethiopians, at a minimum. But even more than that, we should work toward establishing comprehensive legal pathways that enable people to arrive in the United States without risking their life or paying human traffickers their entire savings just to be detained at the border and deported.
Fixing our immigration system is not merely a matter of basic morality, although it is that. It is also the right way to address the very real problems that are created when millions of people mass at designated ports of entry and then are either detained or sent to overstretched cities around the country. As heated as the debate over the veracity of asylum claims has become, the very fact that so many people are seeking asylum shows us that many people are trying to arrive here legally. We should give them the opportunity to do so.
And we must reject the cynicism of those who indulge in xenophobia, or promise to close immigration pathways, because they believe that those positions will prove politically advantageous. Untold numbers of people around the world are counting on us to do the right thing. I dreamed of one day living in the United States when I was huddled in a refugee camp; today millions of children are dreaming the same dream, of living in a country that promises peace and opportunity. I hope that the door that saved my life can be opened even wider.
* * *

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 6/20/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, June 20, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Future of Colorado charter schools could be determined by Democratic primary for a State Board of Ed seat](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Hundreds of thousands of dollars are being spent to affect the primary for a seat on the [state Board of Education](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a race that could determine the future of Colorado charter schools for years to come.
What's at stake is the panel's willingness to [overturn local districts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) when they reject a charter school's application.
Nearly $685,000 from [Progressives Supporting Teachers and Students](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a pro-charter school state-level super PAC, has poured into the contest in the 2nd Congressional District to support education consultant Marisol Lynda Rodriguez in her bid against former Boulder Valley School Board President Kathy Gebhardt.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[1st Amendment case of Jack Phillips and Masterpiece Cakeshop in front of Colorado Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NATIONAL REVIEW](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Jack Phillips of Masterpiece Cakeshop faces [another legal challenge](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado, centered on his refusal to make a cake for a gender transition, despite prior U.S. Supreme Court protections for his First Amendment rights.
* Colorado courts have repeatedly ruled against Phillips, compelling him to act against his religious beliefs, despite clear [Supreme Court precedents](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) supporting his freedom of speech.
* This ongoing case underscores the tension between enforcing state anti-discrimination laws and respecting [individual constitutional rights](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), highlighting broader societal conflicts over compelled speech and religious freedom.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[McKenna: Of our race-obsessed schools and special populations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY STEPHEN MCKENNA, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)| COMMENTARY
_The Cherry Creek School Board meeting in April featured a strategic plan update on special populations by Dr. Tony Poole. Those not steeped in the priorities of the school board and Superintendent Chris Smith might think it wise to fixate on "disproportionality" as Dr. Poole does; but that fixation does not seem to be improving proficiency in reading or math, where half the district's students do not test at grade level. Or much else._
_Dr. Poole and his team of seven special populations directors (each paid between $100,000 to $155,000 a year, while teachers make between $58,710 and $119,532) track disproportionality across the district 's special education (SPED) and gifted and talented (GT) programs. Disproportionalities are tracked against goals established by the district's strategic plan and the Colorado Department of Education (CDE)._
_While disproportionality could be tracked in many ways - gender, socio-economic status, parental involvement, height, weight, IQ, etc. - Dr. Poole's presentation focused on race and only race. Race is very much in focus in much of the school district's work._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In Colorado, only one town lets nonresidents vote. Now it's considering adding LLCs to voter rolls.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Mountain Village, Colorado, unique for allowing [nonresident property owners](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to vote in local elections, is considering extending voting rights to LLCs and trusts owning property within the town.
* The proposal could add approximately 719 new voters to the rolls, including [566 LLCs and 153 trusts](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), expanding influence in town decisions to corporate entities.
* Local residents express mixed reactions, with some seeing it as addressing [voter disenfranchisement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while others worry about the impact of absentee and profit-driven owners on local governance.
* The town council is collecting public input and will move forward with readings of the proposal in upcoming meetings, potentially leading to a [special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for residents to decide on the charter amendments.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado Dems applaud Biden's latest immigration order, while Republicans call it 'madness'](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Democrats praised President Biden's [executive order](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to protect from deportation hundreds of thousands of undocumented spouses and children of U.S. citizens, viewing it as a step towards fixing the immigration system and keeping families together.
* Republican critics labeled the order as [madness and unconstitutional](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), with former President Trump and Rep. Lauren Boebert asserting it bypasses Congress and jeopardizes American security.
* The policy, announced on the [anniversary of DACA](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), aims to stabilize families by allowing certain undocumented immigrants to work legally in the U.S. and potentially gain citizenship, which has sparked a stark partisan divide on its implications for immigration and election-year politics.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Following backlash, Douglas Co. school board delays discussion, action on trans student policy](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DOUGLAS COUNTY NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Douglas County School Board has indefinitely postponed a vote on updating [discrimination policies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to protect transgender students due to substantial opposition.
* Proposed changes aimed to comply with [federal Title IX updates](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and a Colorado law to prevent discrimination against transgender and nonbinary students, particularly in sports and locker rooms.
* [Over 100 emails](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) were received by the board, prompting a delay to better understand the policy's impacts. The decision to table the discussion was made by a 4-3 vote without a set date to revisit the issue.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[10.5% of ballots have been cast in primary election statewide; 12.7% in 4th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** ******BY BRIAN PORTER | STATE | JUNE 18**
_About 12.7 percent of all registered primary voters in Colorado 's 4th District have cast a ballot and among those 34.1 percent are unaffiliated voters, the Secretary of State's first daily report of the election reads._ ****
**[Legal battle heating up from the killing of a Trump supporter by 9News' unlicensed, contracted security guard](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF | STATE | JUNE 18** _The Colorado Court of Appeals has found Denver 's 9News could potentially be held liable in a fatal shooting of a Trump supporter during a 2020 protest in Denver_
**[Transform Colorado events slated to unite Christian, church leaders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF**** | STATE | JUNE 17** _The first of three Transform Colorado events will take place Tuesday, June 18, with two more events following Wednesday, June 19, with guest speaker William J. Federer._**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**__

Peter, Monday will be the two-year anniversary of the _Dobbs_ decision from the Supreme Court, the one that overturned the right to an abortion in our country and set the far-right out on a crusade to restrict and outright ban the procedure in states around the country. The country was handed a win last week when the Supreme Court decided to throw out the case challenging access to mifepristone, a safe and effective drug used for medication abortion. **But we know that the fight is not over. ** That’s why it’s just as important as ever that we stand together in the face of attacks against abortion. [_**Will you add your name to fight alongside me to protect abortion access today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87272769/480600575/252148044?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240620_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODg5ZDYxNi0zMzJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lsZiYDVoi9AIshlMDEsrZcFbFzuxTglKkW0EhQt9kS4=&emci=ed7dbb23-9f2d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b889d616-332f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15353729) | [PROTECT ABORTION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87272770/480600576/252148044?refcode=AU_TK_EG_GEN_PET_AC_20240620_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiODg5ZDYxNi0zMzJmLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lsZiYDVoi9AIshlMDEsrZcFbFzuxTglKkW0EhQt9kS4=&emci=ed7dbb23-9f2d-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=b889d616-332f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=15353729)

Thank you for standing up today!
Tina
