clean_body: | Peter, Monday will be the two-year anniversary of the Dobbs decision from the Supreme Court, the one that overturned the right to an abortion in our country and set the far-right out on a crusade to restrict and outright ban the procedure in states around the country. The country was handed a win last week when the Supreme Court decided to throw out the case challenging access to mifepristone, a safe and effective drug used for medication abortion. But we know that the fight is not over. That’s why it’s just as important as ever that we stand together in the face of attacks against abortion. | The Dobbs decision made it clear that even the rights we consider most fundamental are always at risk. Two years later, we continue the fight to protect full access to reproductive health care and other rights we may be taking for granted. Thank you for standing up today! I just turned in a huge stack of petition signatures, which means I am officially running for reelection to the U.S. Senate!
I'm running for two main reasons:
1. We’re losing the middle in the Senate.
2. There’s a lot left to do.
In a Congress and nation that is deeply partisan, my position as an Independent has helped bridge the divide. And we’ve gotten some important things done in the last few years -–the CARES Act to send direct economic assistance to American families and businesses hurting during the COVID pandemic, the Great American Outdoors Act to protect our public lands, the PACT Act to expand benefits for our veterans, the $1.2 trillion Bipartisan Infrastructure bill, and the CHIPS and Science Act which has already resulted in an explosion of investment in bringing semiconductor manufacturing back home. All of these accomplishments were the result of bipartisan negotiation, debate, and compromise. And it’s that spirit of working together I'm afraid we’re losing.
Our work isn’t done. From the unsustainable cost of prescription drugs to the unacceptable attacks on reproductive rights, our nation is grappling with serious and complex issues.
I’m going to keep doing what I always have: encourage compassion and civility and try to bring people and politicians together across party lines to get things done. clean_body: Let me introduce myself| | | Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military. I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today. I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. I'm now the OFFICIAL GOP nominee running for the U.S. Senate in Virginia because our voters believe our country needs true conservative leaders who put service over self. I put my life on the line for our American values and freedom because I know that America is worth defending. But today, career politicians like Tim “Hillary” Kaine are eroding the very liberties my fellow troops and I risked the ultimate sacrifice for. They've lost sight of what matters and are more interested in playing political games than serving the people they're supposed to represent. Now, I'm stepping up because we need a change. I fought for this country once, taking on terrorists face to face - I'm certainly not afraid to take on establishment politicians. We need strong leaders who will put the hardworking American people before special interests and the Clinton family insiders. I've made a commitment to our country before, and now, I'm ready to make a new one as a U.S. Senator. I'm not done with my mission for America, and I need your help to finish it. Fellow Conservative, I wanted to take a moment and share three words with you that are very meaningful to me.

_**Sacrifice, Duty, and Honor.**_

These words symbolize the commitment our veterans, including my husband, have shown to our country, and for that I will be forever grateful.

Nancy Dahlstrom Announces Statewide Campaign Finance Committee
*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|*

View this email in your browser

<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=69280&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=61727>

June 20, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Nancy Dahlstrom Announces Statewide Campaign Finance Committee

ANCHORAGE, AK - Today, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom announced her
Statewide Campaign Finance Committee co-chairs for her congressional
campaign to unseat Mary Peltola and return conservative Alaskan values
to Washington. Dahlstrom's Campaign Finance Committee is made up of
staunch conservative Alaskans who desire to see our state's leadership
at the national level reflect our state's values.

The announcement comes on the heels of the most important endorsement
of the race: President Donald Trump announced his endorsement of
Dahlstrom in AK-AL. President Trump joins Governor Mike Dunleavy,
Speaker Mike Johnson, Leader Steve Scalise, Whip Tom Emmer, and
Chairwoman Elise Stefanik. The broad local and national coalition
coalescing around Dahlstrom gives her a clear momentum ahead of the
November election.

"I'm proud to have these incredible Alaska leaders in my corner as we
seek to bring proven, tough, Alaska first leadership back to Congress,"
stated Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom. "It's time to end the disastrous
tenure of Mary Peltola and Joe Biden, who have spent their time in
power shutting down Alaska and dictating how we should live our lives.
We are building the team and momentum we need to win this November."

"Nancy Dahlstrom is our state's best hope at returning common sense,
conservative Alaskan leadership to the House. Now more than ever, we
need leaders like Nancy to defend and promote the values that make our
nation the greatest in the world, especially as our global adversaries
see weakness in Washington," said SCI Chapter President John Sturgeon.
"I am honored and proud to be a finance chair for Nancy's campaign. I
look forward to seeing her unseat Mary Peltola in November and return
the spirit of Alaska to Washington."

The committee, which represents key leaders from across of Alaska,
includes:

* John Binkley, Business Owner, Former State Senator, and
Representative
* John Sturgeon, Outdoorsman, SCI Chapter President
* Jay Ramras, Former State Representative and Fairbanks Business
Owner
* John Sims, President of ENSTAR Natural Gas Company
* Mike Robbins, Anchorage Community Development Authority
Executive Director
* Natasha Von Imhof, Former State Senator
* Bert Stedman, State Senator
* Charisse Millett, Former State Representative and Executive
Director of PSEA
* Eddie Grasser, Former Director of Wildlife Conservation
* Todd Smoldon, Director Matanuska-Susitna Office of the Governor
* Carol Fraser, Vice President Aspen Hotels
* Nona Safra, Board Member Alaska Commission on Aging

Friend, Across the country, utility monopolies are charging higher prices for worse service―padding the pockets of investors while residents experience power outages during extreme heat and cold. The vast majority of Americans live paycheck to paycheck and can’t afford skyrocketing rates for essential services. Michigan’s investor-owned utility monopoly DTE has some of the worst service in the nation, and some of the highest rates. DTE recently requested an additional rate hike that would cost our residents $450 million. **Utilities are able to get away with these outrageous rate hikes because they use their profits to buy political favors rather than improve service for customers.** For example,**** DTE has donated to a whopping 93% of Michigan state lawmakers. I’m proud to have endorsed one of Michigan’s lawmakers who does _not_ take money from DTE. **State Representative Dylan Wegela has introduced legislation in the Michigan legislature that bans utilities, monopoly corporations, and corporations seeking government contracts from making political contributions.** [**Add your name calling on Congress to pass identical legislation and hold greedy monopoly corporations and utilities accountable. This is how we make sure more people can afford life-sustaining utility services and stay in their homes.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39HE-uMWsUwhaRAejGucUlE5HEx5JfxKPFpI4Bscj0J3k2CymacQphU8kzL--hXyM6kIRxkoUo2q2UKajbtd7Oz2x9cEqJ1uXiQpp4X6RCFYTuXvqD8XDGXLNVfINdzp4h1fDybkRXz545FDeOJvCGhKEFTgwKg_kasLWe63mRleQI8Vlq4PMGt3TWaWAm7ue_nVxCCXlBur0maMZHL0oD51Hh2YTLCTnYSWV3NdoXB7kscd0rnA5TpqHXLI346Dbwnlw1VntZf4BcpjpMOckTn0AO3ZPDoa4E6JdohhSB1ZU9kYTjnFrhGJpKjd-YvVRc8mS76TznkgUTD2BEdJYs3ypEHNOKOF9fq54UeCrhnKkFA5FITBML1aKeBNrGAvm8nuetMTzcYeFCIcF0tcbSlXBSL5vQ38xOwkd6dcKknPw0WnddVhKAbn9ceIqsRdrGQGrrpU1_XAWs3QQPlqMpwiT1Ef-a0Jyj3J-A3gGXQr-lLkk48TnUbZ_sYYJXioW_xjy7hubclHYfWu7sr_obEmLlmyvzn-ohnyIYR-GEDTA/47d/OgzEHiTmQmaRArbJMOhsuw/h1/h001.k1acTYqCYXrhWhG2oLDLZxN1d0EFAaVKRf33uzXvSng) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39HE-uMWsUwhaRAejGucUlE5HEx5JfxKPFpI4Bscj0J3k2CymacQphU8kzL--hXyM6kIRxkoUo2q2UKajbtd7Oz2x9cEqJ1uXiQpp4X6RCFYTuXvqD8XDGXLNVfINdzp4h1fDybkRXz545FDeOJvCGhKEFTgwKg_kasLWe63mRleQI8Vlq4PMGt3TWaWAm7ue_nVxCCXlBur0maMZHL0oD51Hh2YTLCTnYSWV3NdoXB7kscd0rnA5TpqHXLI346Dbwnlw1VntZf4BcpjpMOckTnAuQ3sMA6h2OLenjudTegjAEH6khzPIM-vqTwp6HK4r9IE11hq3d_IwDbTpZM2u-Lo36TvKvEZ_amAk2527P0jaYg7sFnDG2ZCM3KFijKDKQ8prIeJbOh641ibYUH0B55_bPZFoTBozxpFyPfN5FAhAsvn_rYO1s_-MBqamEa88rNRbojZlQS-wE446NxSalJHJiB_zSh8E3tb11SJLWnVgDDljDX12-KpYed45BgmgN5x_P06BCg0MRhnpUT1Fe9Nu9AQwgxkr4a8nT56oPFDw/47d/OgzEHiTmQmaRArbJMOhsuw/h2/h001.r5AMWqjOcHSPXSRM8GR7xWx2yj76kULNbIUk96sICis)

body:
| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=0eae233275c14ae7af364f2dcde22a7b&_e=rd6s2blF7ea9a9spbayRT5OiDEeWsz6gWsiY7I6SXiq_QKBE3LS_LmFzYqFb8r3e5zDQWMU4HXrqdPW17QJYU6_2LS2ED01TxDfSGTGIjRJHIilEVyS0tzXVb-rjl0751l9SXE3abwS8eAcz1opoul5orke2ZEhkT79q1PBXFoZifa_oZlwRMcKYjsscczVm2YVFrJrSl-vXC9Q0F_YH7EDx6gYHLEOalTdfa5VQxyOz0ytt9-rCxSyobSTdEKZr92HuVjlY23m1dzV63sGjFvobuxnwbeYeff2TbNpDUPESTpRXuoVuZp44jcjem7ocODRglc_7w0ouxwiZ8I4n8Mc9lC951vq4JveY_J4U1Xze0YDvIvwxlSko9vKfurupZ-7ilgZKctHqnpVEEjeB_7kGUrOzRmSHKHQLaT0f71U%3D)
---
_**If you're not one to read your emails, I'd recommend starting today.**_ **This letter directly impacts YOU, neighbor.**

As I campaign through our state, I'm struck by the countless forgotten faces - the struggling families, homeless neighbors, and those clinging to the fringes of society. _**Their great need can no longer be ignored.**_

I've looked into the eyes of many folks at encampments across our state and seen the extinguished light of hope and promise. Of teens tied to gangs as their only chance at belonging. Of hardworking men and women willing to take any job, trapped in poverty's vicious cycle.

Liberal failing leaders cannot claim to be promoting a compassionate, prosperous society while millions of our own continue to be left behind. **[As your next Governor, I vow to finally extend a hand to those who've been shamefully neglected for too long.](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=0eae233275c14ae7af364f2dcde22a7b&_e=rd6s2blF7ea9a9spbayRT5OiDEeWsz6gWsiY7I6SXiq_QKBE3LS_LmFzYqFb8r3e5zDQWMU4HXrqdPW17QJYU6_2LS2ED01TxDfSGTGIjRJHIilEVyS0tzXVb-rjl0751l9SXE3abwS8eAcz1opoul5orke2ZEhkT79q1PBXFoZifa_oZlwRMcKYjsscczVm2YVFrJrSl-vXC9Q0F_YH7EDx6gYHLEOalTdfa5VQxyOz0ytt9-rCxSyobSTdEKZr92HuVjlY23m1dzV63sGjFsZEl3P8VjHJINRE8IlE0_gWIyHB1c_bGbQT8ttcP1x3cQp4VRhIMurJW6zSlWnsGpBY33euQ-Fqlro0NgVC521JPjnoQVCTnvv32A4PLOUQXJpuv30BeGB1L8lC1mG-PW9C-mjXT85wL--7IV_Lacc%3D)**

But I cannot wage this battle alone. I need your support to lift up our forgotten neighbors and create a Washington where opportunity and dignity are accessible to all.

It starts by addressing the root causes too often ignored - from lack of housing and living-wage jobs to issues like substance abuse and mental health crises. **The Left thinks the solution is free needles and tents. I'm developing rehabilitation, housing, and job placement programs.**

This is how we start tackling poverty and societal ills in a meaningful, lasting way - extending a hand up, not just a handout. No more looking the other way at our fellow citizens' suffering.

**[So I humbly ask you today: will you donate $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can afford to fuel this moral mission of restoring dignity and opportunity for all?](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=0eae233275c14ae7af364f2dcde22a7b&_e=rd6s2blF7ea9a9spbayRT5OiDEeWsz6gWsiY7I6SXiq_QKBE3LS_LmFzYqFb8r3e5zDQWMU4HXrqdPW17QJYU6_2LS2ED01TxDfSGTGIjRJHIilEVyS0tzXVb-rjl0751l9SXE3abwS8eAcz1opoul5orke2ZEhkT79q1PBXFoZifa_oZlwRMcKYjsscczVm2YVFrJrSl-vXC9Q0F_YH7EDx6gYHLEOalTdfa5VQxyOz0ytt9-rCxSyobSTdEKZr92HuVjlY23m1dzV63sGjFj1c51awk7rza9O1sfDYBhOSuCOKDJjjfv8zjFOLVt63bv1OfTfKorStWg81NzIM-tar95sSz3VSvWnlddQzPKI-T1-AR3YNyBIOQHfNLw7z_0Sm7jTL_33O3t1dvMb9TYWhrZotBy_sUjztslVMuOM%3D)** To look out across our communities and finally see the light of hope returned to every forgotten face?

The task ahead will not be easy. But our calling is clear. It's time we Washingtonians finally aid our most vulnerable neighbors and rediscover the state we love. **[Help me as I help Washington. clean_body: | If you're not one to read your emails, I'd recommend starting today. This letter directly impacts YOU, neighbor. As I campaign through our state, I'm struck by the countless forgotten faces - the struggling families, homeless neighbors, and those clinging to the fringes of society. Their great need can no longer be ignored. I've looked into the eyes of many folks at encampments across our state and seen the extinguished light of hope and promise. Of teens tied to gangs as their only chance at belonging. Of hardworking men and women willing to take any job, trapped in poverty's vicious cycle. Liberal failing leaders cannot claim to be promoting a compassionate, prosperous society while millions of our own continue to be left behind. But I cannot wage this battle alone. I need your support to lift up our forgotten neighbors and create a Washington where opportunity and dignity are accessible to all. It starts by addressing the root causes too often ignored - from lack of housing and living-wage jobs to issues like substance abuse and mental health crises. The Left thinks the solution is free needles and tents. I'm developing rehabilitation, housing, and job placement programs. This is how we start tackling poverty and societal ills in a meaningful, lasting way - extending a hand up, not just a handout. No more looking the other way at our fellow citizens' suffering. To look out across our communities and finally see the light of hope returned to every forgotten face? The task ahead will not be easy. But our calling is clear. Press releases flew out of Capitol Hill. Social media platforms twittered. Cable news filled with righteous indignation.

**But only a few Senators actually _did_ something.**

❌ Any new political or judicial appointments; and,

❌ Any expedited consideration of Democrat legislation not related to national security.

Thanks to a groundswell of grassroots support, more Senators have joined the letter since it was originally released, bringing the total number to 14. And the pressure continues to mount. There is no reason Republican Senators should fund Joe Biden's law-fare or confirm the dangerous political nominees wielding it. **SENATE CONSERVATIVES**

An unspoken secret in Congress is that much of the reflexive, blind, unconditional vote support for nearly any Israeli government action isn’t from actual agreement.
It’s from fear.
Reps are terrified of this ⬇️. Of AIPAC. **So they don’t vote their conscience. They vote their fear.**

**Here are the states we’re targeting — and why:**
→ **Arizona:** Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process.
→ **Michigan:** While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission.
→ **New Hampshire:** It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest.
→ **Pennsylvania:** Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority *and* flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta and have the ability to enact redistricting reform in Pennsylvania.
→ **Wisconsin:** Thanks to the state supreme court striking down Republican-drawn gerrymanders, Wisconsinites have their first opportunity in over a decade to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. With ongoing investment, we can build power and ensure fair maps are drawn moving forward.
While each of these states has a unique profile and different goals, they all need our help.

Thank you,
Claire Low

clean_body: Here’s what these 5 states all have in common | Peter, I want to take a moment to explain why our new partnership with The States Project focuses on winning legislative races in five specific states where our work can make a big difference. Below, I’ll go in more detail about each state we’re prioritizing together. = | If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = Here are the states we’re targeting — and why: → Arizona: Republicans hold majorities in both chambers of the Arizona legislature, but if we flip just two seats in each, we can flip both the House and Senate and strengthen the state’s redistricting process. → Michigan: While Democrats hold a trifecta in Michigan, Republicans are trying to take back the House this November. If they do, they could attempt to roll back progress on fair maps by targeting the state’s independent redistricting commission. → New Hampshire: It’s the Republicans who hold a trifecta in New Hampshire — and since mid-cycle Congressional redistricting is permitted in this state, the GOP could choose to rewrite their maps at any given moment. Democrats need to win the legislature to put that possibility of mid-cycle GOP gerrymandering to rest. → Pennsylvania: Democrats hold the House and the governor’s seat, but Republicans control the Senate. If we can protect the House majority and flip the Senate, we will achieve another Democratic trifecta and have the ability to enact redistricting reform in Pennsylvania. → Wisconsin: Thanks to the state supreme court striking down Republican-drawn gerrymanders, Wisconsinites have their first opportunity in over a decade to elect a legislature that reflects the will of the people. With ongoing investment, we can build power and ensure fair maps are drawn moving forward. While each of these states has a unique profile and different goals, they all need our help. = Thank you, Claire Low = = Since 2017, the NDRC has executed a comprehensive redistricting strategy that shifts the redistricting power, creating fair districts where Democrats can compete. name: Sarah McBride HQ
subject: Let us explain
body:
June 30 is a really important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline for most political campaigns.
#
Hey,
You’re going to get a lot of fundraising emails (like this one!) over the next couple weeks.
**There’s a good reason for that, too. Something big is coming up.**
June 30 is a really important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline for most political campaigns — but it’s especially crucial for ours. **It’s our final end-of-quarter deadline before the primary.**
After the June 30 deadline, our campaign is required to submit a public fundraising report to the Federal Elections Commission (FEC). This report will show our supporters and opponents the strength of our movement heading into the primary election on September 10.
**If we fail to post a strong report that shows we can win in September AND November, it could encourage right-wing super PACs and special interests to dump money into trying to defeat us.**
That’s why we’re reaching out to ask you for your support before the FEC report is due.
[**Can you make a $5 contribution ahead of this big moment for our campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240620-1?refcode=em20240620-1-663&amount=5&refcode2=663_21716_LJ1VSD&akid=663%2E21716%2ELJ1VSD) _Every donation made before the clock strikes midnight on June 30 will be included in our next fundraising report._
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240620-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240620-1-663&refcode2=663_21716_LJ1VSD&akid=663%2E21716%2ELJ1VSD)**
On top of our report being heavily scrutinized, we’re also making **significant budget decisions** with less than 100 days to go until our primary election — like booking TV ad time!

[**Right now, the most important thing you can do to help Sarah win is to donate to our campaign. Can you make a donation of $5 or any amount you can?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240620-1?refcode=em20240620-1-663&amount=5&refcode2=663_21716_LJ1VSD&akid=663%2E21716%2ELJ1VSD)

Team McBride

Friend -- There was a time when Americans overcame tremendous natural barriers to build great infrastructure projects that transformed the nation into an agro-industrial power house. With the Erie Canal and the Croton Aqueduct as a model, New York State, especially through the development of the Army Corp of Engineers at West Point, led the way in these great endeavors throughout the nation, and, in fact, throughout the world. As my campaign has stated, today we must turn “swords into plowshares” and put our great capabilities back towards the mission of building for mankind instead of destroying on behalf of a decadent and desperate financial oligarchy. The world is moving towards win-win cooperation based on peaceful development. It’s time for the United States to resume its historic role as the American Republic, not the British Empire.

subject: celebrating emancipation with action

body:
[1]Powered By People

I’ve been lucky enough over the years to celebrate Juneteenth with the
woman who, more than anyone else, made it an official national holiday,
Opal Lee. Her story and her mission have inspired me and the work we do at
Powered by People.

For Opal, it began in 1939 when her parents bought a home in a
predominantly white neighborhood in Fort Worth, unprecedented for an
African American family like hers at the time.

On June 19th of that year, a mob of hundreds of white rioters raided the
family’s home, terrorizing twelve-year-old Opal and her siblings, burning
their furniture, and threatening their lives all for having the audacity
to live outside of the established color lines of Texas. In the midst of
the attack, Lee’s father grabbed his shotgun but was warned by the Fort
Worth police officers on the scene that if he were to use it, they would
turn the mob loose on his family. The attackers ultimately burned the
house to the ground.

That moment forever changed Opal and her understanding of Juneteenth.

“The fact that it happened on the 19th day of June has spurred me to make
people understand that Juneteenth is not just a festival,” she said from
the steps of her historic Fort Worth home during a speech in early June
2020.

In fact, from 1939 forward, in her roles as an educator, a civic leader,
and a volunteer at her local food pantry, she has helped Texans understand
the deeper lessons of Juneteenth and our country’s history. Juneteenth,
she taught, shouldn’t be a celebration only for African Americans or
Texans. It should be a day that helps Americans from every background
understand that this country’s history belongs to all of us and that our
future as a country depends on each of us. We’re connected, she’d say,
there’s no getting past that.

At the age of eighty-nine, Opal Lee decided to take the conversation
beyond her hometown—traveling the fourteen hundred miles from Fort Worth
to Washington, D.C., to bring attention to Juneteenth. Every morning and
every afternoon, she walked two and a half miles— five miles a day—all
with the goal of making Juneteenth a federal holiday.

I asked her if she thought she’d be successful at the time.

“No, not in my lifetime,” she told me. “But I had to try.”

She told her story along the way, talking with and listening to people all
over the country. She pled her case before members of Congress and
Presidents Obama and Biden. And eventually, her persistence, her courage,
and her story paid off.

On June 17, 2021, President Joe Biden signed the Juneteenth National
Independence Day Act into law, making Juneteenth the first new federal
holiday in thirty-eight years. Opal Lee sat in the front row at the
bill-signing ceremony and received a standing ovation from the assembled
dignitaries.

In his remarks, the president credited her with paving the way for the new
holiday, and he talked about the work necessary to achieve true equality
in America.

“The promise of equality is not going to be fulfilled . . . so long as the
sacred right to vote remains under attack. We see this assault from
restrictive laws, threats of intimidation, voter purges, and more—an
assault that offends our very democracy. We can’t rest until the promise
of equality is fulfilled for every one of us in every corner of this
nation.

“That, to me,” the president concluded, “is the meaning of Juneteenth.”

Opal Lee agreed. In a speech the year before, recounting the burning of
her home and her work to help America meet the promise of emancipation,
she called on her fellow Texans to make themselves heard through our
democracy.

“When you go out and vote—when you make the changes—we can keep America
from burning.”

That’s why on Juneteenth this year, Powered by People volunteers spent the
day both marching with Opal Lee in Fort Worth and working to get eligible
Texans on the rolls. Pictured below is one of our organizers, Athena,
celebrating Juneteenth in a way we know Opal is proud of: registering a
new voter in Texas.

Thank you for supporting our fight for a better Texas and a better
country.

In the midst of the attack, Lee’s father grabbed his shotgun but was warned by the Fort Worth police officers on the scene that if he were to use it, they would turn the mob loose on his family. The attackers ultimately burned the house to the ground. That moment forever changed Opal and her understanding of Juneteenth. “The fact that it happened on the 19th day of June has spurred me to make people understand that Juneteenth is not just a festival,” she said from the steps of her historic Fort Worth home during a speech in early June 2020. In fact, from 1939 forward, in her roles as an educator, a civic leader, and a volunteer at her local food pantry, she has helped Texans understand the deeper lessons of Juneteenth and our country’s history. Juneteenth, she taught, shouldn’t be a celebration only for African Americans or Texans. It should be a day that helps Americans from every background understand that this country’s history belongs to all of us and that our future as a country depends on each of us. We’re connected, she’d say, there’s no getting past that. At the age of eighty-nine, Opal Lee decided to take the conversation beyond her hometown—traveling the fourteen hundred miles from Fort Worth to Washington, D.C., to bring attention to Juneteenth. Every morning and every afternoon, she walked two and a half miles— five miles a day—all with the goal of making Juneteenth a federal holiday. I asked her if she thought she’d be successful at the time. “No, not in my lifetime,” she told me. “But I had to try.” She told her story along the way, talking with and listening to people all over the country. She pled her case before members of Congress and Presidents Obama and Biden. And eventually, her persistence, her courage, and her story paid off. On June 17, 2021, President Joe Biden signed the Juneteenth National Independence Day Act into law, making Juneteenth the first new federal holiday in thirty-eight years. Opal Lee sat in the front row at the bill-signing ceremony and received a standing ovation from the assembled dignitaries. In his remarks, the president credited her with paving the way for the new holiday, and he talked about the work necessary to achieve true equality in America. “The promise of equality is not going to be fulfilled . . . so long as the sacred right to vote remains under attack. We see this assault from restrictive laws, threats of intimidation, voter purges, and more—an assault that offends our very democracy. We can’t rest until the promise of equality is fulfilled for every one of us in every corner of this nation. “That, to me,” the president concluded, “is the meaning of Juneteenth.” Opal Lee agreed. In a speech the year before, recounting the burning of her home and her work to help America meet the promise of emancipation, she called on her fellow Texans to make themselves heard through our democracy. “When you go out and vote—when you make the changes—we can keep America from burning.” That’s why on Juneteenth this year, Powered by People volunteers spent the day both marching with Opal Lee in Fort Worth and working to get eligible Texans on the rolls. Pictured below is one of our organizers, Athena, celebrating Juneteenth in a way we know Opal is proud of: registering a new voter in Texas. Thank you for supporting our fight for a better Texas and a better country. [ ]DONATE $3 Beto

Since then, Adam has been repeatedly attacked by Trump and his cronies, and Republicans have only gotten worse.

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

_“Democratic Efforts to Lure Young Voters Include Beer and Birth Control.”_

That’s how the _Washington Post_ recently described how President Biden’s campaign is working to reach young voters.

Dmitri Mehlhorn – a donor adviser to billionaire Democrats – added, _“No one throws more simultaneous parties than we do.”_

Apparently, no one in the media thinks it’s creepy that rich old guys with an agenda are trying to “lure” young people with alcohol, drugs, and devices that promote risky sexual behavior – after all, in their eyes, the Biden Campaign can do no wrong.

But if you ever wanted to know how important young voters are to pro-abortion politicians, this says everything . . .

With President Biden struggling in the polls – especially with Millennials and Gen Z – his campaign is getting desperate.

And a BIG part of the reason why is your ongoing support for our efforts to reach young people!

_Yes, the same young people who, when asked honestly via our polling, REJECT Biden's abortion extremism._

**[So, can I count on you for a generous contribution to help _Students for Life Action_ keep our momentum going](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ggttht-duchtdja-y/)?**

The fact is, we're the ONLY national pro-life group working to turn young people against abortion-on-demand.

And our efforts are working – thanks to your support.

**You see, after the 2022 elections, I promised all of our supporters we were going to double down on our efforts to reach young people.**

As A.B. Stoddard put it in an op-ed for RealClearPolitics.com, “Republicans basically won everyone but the young.”

So, we launched a campaign, _The Campus Takeover,_ with the goal of having a _Students for Life_ presence on EVERY four-year college and university campus in EVERY Battleground State.

We launched a 40-state, 160-campus National Tour to expose the dangers of Chemical Abortion Pills in the spring of 2023.

We launched another 40-state tour, _“What Is a Person”_ in the fall of 2023.

_Then, we hit another 150+ campuses this spring explaining to college students all the ugly ways abortions are committed_.

Whether it’s training young people, reaching MILLIONS online with our digital programs, or mobilizing young people to pass or defeat legislation, the workload has been utterly INSANE.

But there’s good news . . .

**Because of all of the work you’ve enabled us to accomplish with your generosity, we now have the momentum.**

Democrats have a crisis on their hands with young voters as they increasingly disapprove of President Biden _despite his flashy parties._

Even _NPR_ reports that 62% have an “unfavorable opinion of him [the president].”

Media elites and their pals in the Abortion Lobby are FREAKING OUT over headlines like this one I saw in _The Hill_ recently . . .

_“Democrats Worry Young People Souring on Party.”_

Which means the Abortion Lobby is losing its grip on its target demographic.

And they’re stooping to absurd levels just to get their claws back into the minds of young people . . . by getting them drunk and encouraging them to have reckless sex?

Are these really the people we want running our country?

_I don’t!_

**That’s why it’s more important than ever to support the critical work of _Students for Life Action_ to reach these voters and turn them towards Life!**

**[So, we would appreciate you agreeing to your most generous contribution to ensure November is a landslide victory for Life](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail19.com/t/j-l-ggttht-duchtdja-j/).**

Together, we can bring young people to stand up for Life and defeat the Abortion Goliath!

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=d76e6fa93d57427b908f6713510f2e05&_e=MsV9hmcvOpBp20IkQpxzzMo74U-_eUGTTsIOjfZFW15ha_nxBNG-yi20uAk9zeRj0ZfktCOkpyi-nwxLFotZKkaBPbQM_y2gJWUlXLgvm_LmsuvNrUU5WcnL5MTGAIp-gm_MV55UVWKpCmVaHS3P6RmXRs0NkkA1-Bt5ZD5AvCdJ5QEfWbgM2N8zwOPJR6isBPGZqxqNS4oGsvnG4uKth-2kuTGQb3wHIDA1-Dc2Vw536Ye0tEXPxgEIHS4F69cs0zCWb7S3GgpcFUVJlICApkhuDQhrufSwJrvhL3eBxuo6B0Uzwm6LuHCugwuRP0Rt3b43D9QI-85TvpJLuuqu4Qc_oeA7DmFhghE3qlIlC5NV8jPq186Vxafyg-tx_XuW)

I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. **
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=d76e6fa93d57427b908f6713510f2e05&_e=MsV9hmcvOpBp20IkQpxzzMo74U-_eUGTTsIOjfZFW15ha_nxBNG-yi20uAk9zeRj0ZfktCOkpyi-nwxLFotZKkaBPbQM_y2gJWUlXLgvm_LmsuvNrUU5WcnL5MTGAIp-gm_MV55UVWKpCmVaHS3P6RmXRs0NkkA1-Bt5ZD5AvCdJ5QEfWbgM2N8zwOPJR6isBPGZqxqNS4oGsvnG4uKth51DWYWM1tVq6xAsAUOT3NeyuhSVOKLjvnLkQL9BRO_UveDLk4QqXw7BftHKGlzeRqQDft1Q9_UuBjqhF0uzm1D0xXdecdi87_tccxISVtfOulHOrHQsIkUS5Z1ly24cyfKGZ5yAuKEsUyO174Z0Oe6nhSeVlS46KJZ-klQxJe-Q)

_If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today._

**I answered the call to duty when I was appointed to the Naval Academy as a young man. Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again._But my new mission is a little different._**
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=d76e6fa93d57427b908f6713510f2e05&_e=MsV9hmcvOpBp20IkQpxzzMo74U-_eUGTTsIOjfZFW15ha_nxBNG-yi20uAk9zeRj0ZfktCOkpyi-nwxLFotZKkaBPbQM_y2gJWUlXLgvm_LmsuvNrUU5WcnL5MTGAIp-gm_MV55UVWKpCmVaHS3P6RmXRs0NkkA1-Bt5ZD5AvCdJ5QEfWbgM2N8zwOPJR6isBPGZqxqNS4oGsvnG4uKth1DZhjYKsI6lnrg4d9JpuA_98L_IqEWY5q2h_KtBShJx1Fuu75wHWsKqRhOUUSRtyPOKlEsJAhXt6LVQ6_55_7vLbk3r7uL6PM6QFNkNkneDFv3kQusxDdVTndxGrN279Uq0Gi4lIlwwJx48mK-7EyVfEoad8L7NeQEQvMAPkq09)

Now, I'm answering the call of duty to Americans once again.But my new mission is a little different. subject: We're Taking the Red Line to the Ballot Box

body:
You may have missed this update...

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/illinois?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=resend_red_line&n=1)
---
Peter, We are resending this email to people who may have missed it the first time. We are going to fill you in on some campaign news, but before we do, we wanted to send you this amazing quote from a supporter in Indiana. Hazim writes: _“As an American with conscience and a Muslim, I see Jill Stein as the answer to our endless non-stop prayers for justice and freedom over the course of this Genocide. Presidential candidate Stein is the only hope to end Genocide and bring down a corporate driven Empire that is impoverishing the American people and enslaving others across the globe through its imperialistic project for world hegemony and the enrichment of special interest groups. “We the people” have drawn a**red line around the (White) House of Empire, and we the people shall extend it to every state and every city, and bring it to every ballot box** to defeat duopoly and turn our grassroot movement into a tsunami of votes in November for the first ever anti-war, anti-genocide, pro-peace, pro-people president for the United States of America.”_ Hazim is absolutely correct. Jill Stein is the only anti-genocide candidate who will be on a majority of ballots in November. **_But to ensure that millions of voters like Hazim in Indiana and Illinois have Jill on their ballots, we need to be raising $20,000 a day this month, and we are falling short._** Ballot access is our number one priority and our number one expense. We are throwing all our resources so that you and voters like you can “** _turn our grassroot movement into a tsunami of votes_** ” and send Jill to the White House. Peter, will you pitch in today to make sure Jill is on the ballot in November? Any amount helps us get to our goal and allows us to **_take the red line to the ballot box_** :
---

As Jill said in a previous email, **_“as Gaza goes, we all go. If we want any kind of livable future for our children, we can not allow the mass slaughter of innocent people to be normalized. We must do everything in our power to stop it - now._** ” Thank you for your support and for all you’re doing for people, planet, and peace. In gratitude and solidarity, -The Jill Stein 2024 Team One more thing - since we’ve passed the threshold to qualify for federal public matching funds, _every single person who donates will get their contribution matched up to the first $250._ That means a $5 donation is doubled to $10, $100 becomes $200, and your $250 donation is worth a whopping $500 to our campaign! We hope to receive our first matching funds check soon, but **we urgently need donations right now to fund our critical ballot drives with fast-approaching deadlines. Please pitch in anything you can today and get your contribution supercharged by matching funds!**

In each of these historic moments, we were challenged to live up to the essential promise of our nation: preserving a democratic system of government that respects the rights and addresses the needs of all its citizens.

It’s never been more important to safeguard our fragile democracy: as Benjamin Franklin so wisely put it, "A Republic, if you can keep it."
But this election is not just about keeping Donald Trump out. It's about coming together to protect our shared American values and restoring integrity to our government. That's why electing leaders to the Senate that we can be proud of is so important – and why we have to help Elissa Slotkin hold Michigan's Senate seat for Democrats this fall.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Here’s why I’m asking if you can make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign right now
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
We’ve got to shore up our defenses.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2225%2E4032634%2E-LrA3X)
---
It’s starting. Just a couple months ago, a new right-wing Super PAC got off the ground. Its mission: targeting me for defeat this year and boosting one of my GOP opponents. It’s got ties to the Trump administration, Mitch McConnell, and powerful corporate interests — from Big Oil to Big Pharma to the big banks. And they recently disclosed spending tens of thousands of dollars on digital ads — with those ads run by a company that’s worked with Nikki Haley, the House GOP’s campaign arm, and Republican House Majority Leader Steve Scalise (the guy who once called himself “David Duke without the baggage”). Look: defeating us in Massachusetts would virtually guarantee a GOP-controlled Senate. And national Republicans are desperate to take power so they can enact their radical agenda, from banning abortion nationwide to slashing taxes for billionaires and giant corporations. We have to fight back. [**I’m asking if you can make a donation of $28 or any amount to support our re-election campaign right now — because we can’t afford to underestimate how much money national Republicans and outside special interests can spend trying to defeat us.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2253?amount=28&t=8&akid=2225%2E4032634%2E-LrA3X)

---

It’s no secret that big corporations use Super PACs to elect Republicans who’ll keep their taxes low and their regulations light. And it’s no secret that big corporations — along with other powerful right-wing interests — use Super PACs to defeat Democrats who are fighting to put power in the hands of working people. So in the long run, to make our country work not just for a thin slice at the tippy-top but for everyone, we’ve got to overturn Citizens United and enact sweeping anti-corruption legislation (yes, I’ve got a plan for that). But for now, we’ve got to shore up our defenses against Super PAC spending and anything else the far right throws at us. **Together, we’ll keep working to stop big money from drowning out the voices of working families. But our grassroots fundraising model only works if everyone keeps pitching in whatever they can, whenever they can.** [**If it makes sense for you right now, please pitch in a contribution of any amount, and help fight back against the right-wing forces and corporate interests who want me out of the U.S. Senate.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2253?t=14&akid=2225%2E4032634%2E-LrA3X) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth
